items.sourceDescription:
The Daytona traces to 1963, when Rolex conceived it as a professional racing chronograph and named it for the Florida circuit synonymous with high-speed endurance competition. Reference 116519LN represents the previous-generation white gold execution paired with the Oysterflex bracelet, earning its "Ghost" nickname from the quietly monochromatic interplay of polished white gold, a brushed steel-grey dial, bright black subdials, and matte black ceramic bezel. Produced from 2017 through 2023 before being superseded by the current-generation 126519LN, the reference has become one of the most desirable stealth-luxury Daytonas — favored by collectors who prize refined understatement over overt precious-metal signaling within a sports chronograph.

 The 40mm case in 18-karat white gold features the monobloc black Cerachrom ceramic bezel with engraved tachymetric scale and Triplock screw-down crown and pushers. The steel-grey dial carries three contrasting bright black subdials, red "Daytona" text above six o'clock echoing vintage examples, white gold applied Chromalight hour markers, and matching white gold hands. The in-house automatic Caliber 4130 — a self-winding chronograph with column wheel and vertical clutch — delivers a 72-hour power reserve and Superlative Chronometer certification, completed by a black Oysterflex bracelet with white gold Oysterlock safety clasp.

*This timepiece comes with the original white hang tag.

items.model: Patek Philippe Complications 5930P-001 World Time Flyback Chronograph Platinum Green Dial (2021)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
Patek Philippe holds near-mythic status in world-time watchmaking, a Complication its craftsmen refined into an art form through the mid-twentieth century. The 5930 revived one of the maison's rarest ideas, pairing a world timer with a chronograph, a combination Patek first realized in a single 1940 masterpiece before leaving it dormant for decades. Introduced in platinum in 2021, this green-dialed 5930P renders that scarce concept in the brand's most precious metal, a genuine connoisseur's grail.

 The 39.5mm platinum case frames a dial whose emerald-green center wears a hand-applied circular guilloché pattern, ringed by a two-tone day-night indicator and a rotating disc naming all twenty-four cities. Applied white-gold baton indices and leaf hands preside, while a thirty-minute chronograph counter occupies six o'clock. The self-winding CH 28-520 HU caliber drives both the flyback chronograph and the world-time mechanism. A platinum diamond marks six between the lugs, atop a glossy green alligator strap.

Few Complications carry the romance of Patek Philippe's world time, a mechanism the maison perfected with watchmaker Louis Cottier in the 1930s and has since made its own. What elevates the 5231G above its siblings is the dial: a hand-wrought grand feu cloisonné enamel map, an artisanal craft so demanding that few enamellers still master it. Collectors chase these enamel-map world timers as heirs to legendary mid-century references, prizing the marriage of function and miniature art.

 The 38.5mm white gold case keeps a slim, classical profile, its concise lugs and slightly domed crystal deferring entirely to the dial. At the center, a cloisonné enamel scene depicts Oceania and Southeast Asia in vivid greens against a deep blue sea, ringed by a two-tone day-night disc and a rotating chapter naming twenty-four cities. Baton hands read local time, driven by the self-winding Caliber 240 HU, all worn on a navy alligator strap.

items.model: Patek Philippe Grand Complications 7140R-001 'Ladies' Perpetual Calendar Rose Gold Silvery Sunburst Dial Diamond Bezel (2018)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The perpetual calendar ranks among watchmaking's most revered complications, a mechanism so clever it tracks the irregular lengths of months and even leap years, needing no correction until the year 2100. Patek Philippe has mastered it like no other house, and the 7140 brings that pinnacle achievement to a refined feminine form. Far from a diamond-set afterthought, it proves a woman's watch can house the deepest horological substance. Collectors treasure it as a rare feminine grail.

 The 35mm rose gold case is framed by a bezel set with brilliant-cut diamonds, lending sparkle to its proportions. Its silvery sunburst dial orchestrates the perpetual calendar with balance: a day subdial at nine, a month and leap-year indicator at three, a moon phase at six, and the date read around the periphery. Applied rose gold Arabic numerals mark the hours. The ultra-thin self-winding movement drives it, worn on a glossy alligator strap.

 *The Grand Complications Reference 7140R-001 was discontinued in April 2026, and was the first ladies perpetual calendar in Patek's Grand Complications collection (originally launched in 2012).

 *This timepiece comes with three alligator straps, a stylus, a tag, and an additional caseback.

items.model: Patek Philippe Grand Complications 5236P-001 In-Line Perpetual Calendar Platinum Blue Dial (2026)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The 5236P-001 introduced one of the most significant perpetual calendar developments in modern watchmaking. Unveiled at Watches & Wonders 2021, it became the first wristwatch perpetual calendar to display day, date, and month in a single horizontal aperture at twelve — a configuration historically reserved for rare pocket watches and protected here by three pending patents. For collectors of Patek's  Grand Complications , the reference represents a rare instance of genuine mechanical innovation rather than refinement, while the case design draws lineage from the legendary 3448, the maison's first automatic perpetual calendar from 1962.

 The 41.3mm platinum case measures 11.07mm thick and frames a blue dial with black-gradient rim and vertical satin finish, accented by faceted white gold baton hour markers and the in-line calendar aperture at twelve. Moon phase and small seconds occupy six o'clock, with leap year and day/night indications in subsidiary apertures. The self-winding Caliber 31-260 PS QL — built from 503 components and incorporating an off-center platinum mini-rotor — delivers up to 48 hours of reserve. A signature platinum diamond between the lugs at six and a navy alligator strap with platinum fold-over clasp complete the piece.

 *This timepiece comes with a stylus.

items.model: Audemars Piguet Royal Oak 15510OR.OO.D002CR.02 Rose Gold Black Dial
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Royal Oak occupies foundational status in modern watchmaking as Gérald Genta's revolutionary 1972 creation — the reference that defined the luxury sports watch category and forever altered the trajectory of Swiss horology. Reference 15510OR belongs to the 41mm line introduced in 2021, which succeeded the previous 15400 generation and introduced the new in-house Caliber 4302 alongside refined case dimensions. Executed in 18-karat pink gold with a black "Grande Tapisserie" dial and paired with an alligator strap rather than the signature integrated bracelet, this configuration represents one of the most elegant contemporary interpretations of the Royal Oak — offering the icon's architectural DNA in a more refined, dress-oriented format that allows the pink gold and dial texture to command attention independently.

 The 41mm case in 18-karat pink gold measures 10.4mm thick, framed by the signature octagonal bezel with eight hexagonal screws, screw-locked crown, and exhibition sapphire caseback. The black "Grande Tapisserie" dial carries pink gold applied hour markers and Royal Oak hands with luminescent coating alongside a date aperture at three. The in-house automatic Caliber 4302 — 32 jewels operating at 4 Hz — delivers a 70-hour power reserve and is visible through the exhibition caseback, completed by a black alligator strap secured with an 18-karat pink gold AP folding clasp.

In the balanced 37mm size, it wears with unisex versatility, neither too bold nor too discreet. Enthusiasts treat it as the definitive Royal Oak.

 The 37mm stainless steel case wears the Royal Oak's hallmark octagonal bezel, secured by eight hexagonal screws and softened by alternating brushed and polished finishes. Its grey dial showcases the signature Grande Tapisserie guilloché, a waffle-like texture set with applied white gold markers, matching hands, and a date at three. The integrated bracelet flows seamlessly from the case, tapering across the wrist. Inside beats the self-winding Caliber 4302, delivering a generous seventy-hour power reserve.

items.model: F.P.Journe Chronomètre Bleu Ref. CB Tantalum (2022)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
François-Paul Journe occupies an unparalleled position as the preeminent independent watchmaker of the modern era, his eponymous manufacture producing fewer than 900 pieces annually with every component made in-house in Geneva. The Chronomètre Bleu has become his most iconic and beloved creation — a watch that achieved near-mythical status among collectors for its distinctive deep blue chrome dial and its case rendered in tantalum, a rare metal extremely difficult to machine, prized for its anthracite-grey, faintly bluish hue. Named after the Greek myth of Tantalus, the material's perfect corrosion resistance, exceptional hardness, and biocompatibility have made this reference a cult favorite within the rarefied world of independent collecting.

 The 39mm tantalum case measures just 8.3mm thick, framing the signature blue chrome dial with ivory-colored steel hands, central hours and minutes, and small seconds at seven-thirty. The hand-wound Caliber 1304 features bridges and plate in 18-karat rose gold, twin parallel barrels delivering 56 hours of power reserve, an in-line lever escapement, and chronometric balance with four weights. The movement employs Journe's signature "long mystery balance" with the going train concealed beneath the dial, completed by an alligator strap.

 *This timepiece comes on an orange alligator strap, not blue.

items.model: Richard Mille RM 07-01 'Ladies' Black Ceramic Rose Gold Diamond-Set Skeleton Dial (2020)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The  RM 07-01 stands as Richard Mille's principal ladies' reference, conceived to translate the engineering language of the men's tonneau collection into the smallest case proportions in the catalog. The black TZP ceramic execution represents one of the more technically demanding configurations to produce — the material's 1,400 Vickers hardness and superior toughness to sapphire require lengthy diamond-tool machining to shape the complex case geometry. Paired with a rose gold dial framework and diamond-pavé cartouche over a deep blue baseplate, this configuration occupies the intersection of advanced materials science and high jewelry that has defined Richard Mille's appeal among women collectors of contemporary haute horology.

 The tonneau case measures 45.66 x 31.40 x 11.85mm in microblasted black ceramic with rose gold caseband, secured by twelve grade-5 titanium spline screws. The skeletonized dial features a central rose gold diamond-pavé cartouche framing the hours and minutes hands, set against a blue baseplate that reveals the openworked Caliber CRMA2 beneath. Built on a grade-5 titanium baseplate with electroplasma treatment, the automatic movement features a variable-geometry rotor with 5N red gold segments and delivers a 50-hour power reserve, completed by a black rubber strap.

items.model: Richard Mille RM 11-03 Full Rose Gold Flyback Chronograph (2018)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The  RM 11-03 succeeded the iconic RM 011 in 2017, carrying forward the most commercially defining chronograph in Richard Mille's catalog while introducing the new RMAC3 caliber. Inspired by Formula 1 and motorsport — from the racecar-wheel crown to the pedal-motif pushers — the reference established itself as the contemporary expression of the brand's design philosophy. The full rose gold execution stands apart within the RM 11-03 line, as most variants pair precious metal bezels and casebacks with titanium midcases to reduce mass. Producing all three case sections in 18-karat rose gold positions this configuration among the rarer and more substantial iterations of the model.

 The tripartite tonneau case measures 49.94 x 44.50 x 16.15mm entirely in 18-karat rose gold, secured by 20 grade-5 titanium spline screws. The skeletonized dial reveals the automatic Caliber RMAC3, with flyback chronograph, 60-minute countdown at nine, 12-hour totalizer at three, small seconds at six, oversized date at twelve, and month aperture between four and five. This watch is completed by a green textile strap with hook-and-loop closure.

items.model: Rolex Datejust 41 126333 Stainless Steel Yellow Gold Champagne Dial Jubilee
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Rolex Datejust  126333 represents the contemporary evolution of the Datejust collection introduced in 1945 as the world's first self-winding waterproof chronometer wristwatch with automatically changing date display, reimagined in 2016 with updated 41mm proportions and new-generation Caliber 3235 movement offering enhanced precision and extended 70-hour power reserve. This reference combines the classic two-tone construction pairing stainless steel with 18-karat yellow gold creating the distinctive aesthetic Rolex designates as Rolesor with the elegant five-piece link Jubilee bracelet originally created in 1945 specifically for the Datejust and the timeless champagne sunburst dial finish offering versatile elegance suitable for both professional and formal occasions. As a current-production model backed by Rolex's comprehensive warranty and global service network, this Datejust 41 appeals to collectors who value both the heritage of Rolex's most iconic dress watch collection spanning eight decades and accessible luxury through two-tone construction offering precious metal accents at lower cost than solid gold.

 The 41mm case crafted in stainless steel and 18-karat yellow gold features fluted bezel in solid yellow gold creating the signature Datejust profile with distinctive ridged texture, monobloc middle case in stainless steel, polished case flanks, screw-down Twinlock crown with double waterproofness system ensuring 100 meters of water resistance, sapphire crystal with Cyclops lens magnifying the date 2.5 times for easy reading, and screw-down caseback. The champagne sunburst dial displays applied yellow gold stick hour markers at all positions, yellow gold hands, minute track with printed divisions around outer edge, instantaneous date display at 3 o'clock with white background magnified through Cyclops lens, sunburst finish creating radial pattern emanating from center creating warm glow and dimensional depth as dial catches light from different angles. Inside beats the self-winding Caliber 3235 introduced in 2015 featuring Chronergy escapement with optimized geometry providing approximately 15 percent improved power reserve compared to previous generation movements, paramagnetic blue Parachrom hairspring offering superior resistance to shocks and temperature variations, high-performance Paraflex shock absorbers, bidirectional automatic winding via Perpetual rotor, COSC chronometer certification plus additional Superlative Chronometer testing by Rolex guaranteeing precision of minus two to plus two seconds per day after casing, 31 jewels, frequency of 28,800 vibrations per hour, approximately 70 hours of power reserve. Stainless steel and yellow gold five-piece link Jubilee bracelet with semi-circular elements in polished surfaces throughout secures with Oysterclasp folding clasp featuring Easylink 5mm comfort extension link.

 *This timepiece comes with the original white hang tag.

items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Rolex Day-Date 40 in rose gold with a chocolate dial and baguette diamond hour markers represents one of the most tonally cohesive configurations in the current reference — a watch where case metal, dial color, and diamond selection work in deliberate chromatic alignment rather than contrast. The warm brown of the chocolate sunburst dial finds direct resonance with rose gold's blush tones, and the choice of baguette-cut rather than brilliant-cut diamonds throughout — their geometric rectangular forms catching light in long linear flashes rather than the omnidirectional brilliance of round stones — produces a dial of restrained sophistication. The baguette diamond marker configuration appears across the full dial, replacing every standard baton index with a set stone, creating a surface of considerably greater material density than the standard dial without the visual complexity of mixed marker types.

 The 40mm rose gold Oyster case carries a fluted rose gold bezel and screw-down crown. The chocolate sunburst dial presents ten baguette-cut diamond hour markers with larger baguette markers at six and twelve o'clock, a spelled-out day aperture at twelve, and a date window at three o'clock beneath a Cyclops lens. Rose gold pointed hands complete the dial. The President bracelet in rose gold with concealed Crownclasp completes the reference. Caliber 3255 with approximately 70-hour power reserve powers the movement.

 *This timepiece comes with the original white hang tag.

items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Rolex Daytona is Rolex's most historically charged sports reference — a chronograph whose cultural elevation from modest production volumes in the 1960s to the most coveted watch in secondary market history represents one of the most remarkable trajectories in the collecting world. The  126503 delivers that visual heritage with caliber 4130's in-house column-wheel chronograph movement, one of the most technically accomplished chronograph calibers Rolex has produced.

 The 40mm stainless steel Oyster case carries a yellow gold tachymeter bezel engraved with the "Units Per Hour" scale, with yellow gold screw-down chronograph pushers and crown. The black dial presents applied luminous baton hour markers, yellow gold subdial rings at nine, six, and three o'clock for the running seconds, 30-minute, and 12-hour counters respectively. Yellow gold chronograph hands complete the dial. The Oyster bracelet alternates stainless steel outer links with yellow gold centre links. Caliber 4130, self-winding, powers the movement.

 *This timepiece comes with the original white hang tag.

items.model: Patek Philippe Nautilus 5740/1G-001 Perpetual Calendar Moon Phases (2026)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
Introduced in 2018, the 5740/1G marked a pivotal moment in the  Nautilus's   history: the first Grand Complication ever housed within Gérald Genta's 1976 sports design. Patek Philippe accomplished what many considered impossible — fitting a   perpetual calendar   into the Nautilus silhouette while preserving the proportions that define the model. At 8.42mm thick, it remains the thinnest perpetual calendar Patek Philippe has ever produced. For collectors, the reference represents the convergence of the maison's most coveted sports line with its most historically significant complication, making it among the most pursued contemporary Nautilus references.

 The 40mm case in 18-karat white gold frames a sunburst blue dial with the signature horizontally embossed pattern and white gold applied baton hour markers. Three subdials at three, six, and nine o'clock display day, date, month, leap year cycle,   moon phase , and 24-hour indication. The ultra-thin automatic Caliber 240 Q drives the perpetual calendar via a 22-karat gold micro-rotor, visible through the sapphire caseback.

 *This timepiece comes with a stylus.

 *This timepiece has an new-style clasp with a micro adjustment.

items.model: Cartier Santos WGSA0018 Large Rose Gold White Dial (2026)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Santos occupies foundational status in horological history as one of the very first wristwatches ever made. Louis Cartier created it in 1904 for his friend Alberto Santos-Dumont, the Brazilian aviator who needed to read the time without taking his hands from the controls of his aircraft — a problem the pocket watch could not solve. The resulting design established codes that have endured for over 120 years: the square case with rounded angles, exposed screws on the bezel, and integrated bracelet that flow seamlessly from case to wrist. Reference WGSA0018 represents the large execution rendered entirely in 18-karat rose gold, the most opulent metal expression of the model and a continuation of Cartier's most historically significant wristwatch lineage.

 The 39.8mm case in 18-karat rose gold measures 9.08mm thick, distinguished by the signature exposed bezel screws and seven-sided crown set with a faceted sapphire. The silvered opaline dial carries black Roman numerals, a railway inner minute track, blued-steel sword-shaped hands, and a date aperture at six beneath a sapphire crystal. The in-house automatic Caliber 1847 MC delivers a 42-hour power reserve, completed by Cartier's patented QuickSwitch system with two interchangeable bracelets — 18-karat rose gold with SmartLink adjustment and an alligator leather strap with matching rose gold folding buckle.

*The Retail price is $48,800

The Richard Mille RM 07-01  stands as Richard Mille's principal ladies' reference, conceived to translate the engineering language of the men's tonneau collection into the smallest case proportions in the catalog. The pink TZP ceramic execution represents one of the more technically demanding configurations to produce — the material's 1,400 Vickers hardness and superior toughness to sapphire require lengthy diamond-tool machining to achieve the complex tonneau geometry. Combined here with a white gold midcase, a rose gold crown, and a rose gold diamond-pavé dial cartouche, the configuration occupies the intersection of advanced ceramic technology and high jewelry that has defined Richard Mille's standing among women collectors of contemporary haute horology.

 The tonneau case measures 45.66 x 31.40 x 11.85mm with microblasted pink TZP ceramic bezel and caseback flanking a microblasted 18-karat white gold midcase, secured by twelve grade-5 titanium spline screws and accented by a rose gold crown. The skeletonized dial features a central rose gold cartouche pavé-set with brilliant-cut diamonds, framing the hours and minutes hands. Built on a grade-5 titanium baseplate with electroplasma treatment, the automatic Caliber CRMA2 features a variable-geometry rotor and delivers a 50-hour power reserve, completed by a pink rubber strap.

items.sourceDescription:
The Music Edition celebrates Audemars Piguet's longstanding cultural partnership with the music industry — a relationship that has elevated the Royal Oak and  Royal Oak Offshore into one of the most recognized status symbols among artists, producers, and musicians worldwide. Released in 2022 and limited to 500 pieces in titanium, the 37mm reference distills the recording studio into a wearable form: the dial reproduces a VU meter audio equalizer with colorful rectangles ascending from blue through cyan, green, yellow, and red against the Tapisserie pattern, while the crown guards are shaped like mixing console faders sitting in grooved tracks, and the center strap links mimic the pattern of a guitar jack.  The 37mm case in brushed titanium features the signature octagonal bezel with eight hexagonal screws, screw-locked crown, and exhibition caseback. The blue Tapisserie dial carries the printed VU meter equalizer motif, white gold applied hour markers, and Royal Oak hands with luminescent coating beneath the AP logo at twelve. The in-house automatic Caliber 5909 delivers a 60-hour power reserve, completed by five interchangeable "constellation"-textured rubber straps — the primary blue plus four additional colors — with titanium AP pin buckle.

 *Limited Edition of 500 pieces.

 *Additionally, this model includes five total rubber straps in different colors, offering versatility and customization to suit different styles and occasions.

items.model: Audemars Piguet Royal Oak 15550BA.OO.1356BA.01 Yellow Gold Turquoise Stone Dial (2025)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
This reference marked a notable revival for Audemars Piguet when it debuted in 2023: the first Royal Oak ever to feature a natural turquoise stone dial, reviving the maison's celebrated 1960s and 1990s tradition of stone-dial creations. Throughout those decades, AP cut Royal Oak dials from lapis lazuli, aventurine, garnet, mother-of-pearl, opal, ruby, and amethyst — a practice that had largely fallen dormant. Turquoise, prized by Egyptian and Chinese civilizations over three thousand years ago for its singular color, makes its first appearance in the collection here. As one of the very few "no-tapisserie" Royal Oaks, this reference departs from the model's signature engine-turned dial pattern entirely.

 The 37mm case in 18-karat yellow gold measures just 8.9mm thick, satin-brushed with polished bevels and the signature octagonal bezel. The natural turquoise dial — every example unique in its matrix patterning — carries yellow gold applied baton hour markers and luminescent Royal Oak hands, with a date aperture at three set against a tone-on-tone background. The self-winding Caliber 5900, visible through the sapphire caseback, delivers a 60-hour power reserve via a decorated gold rotor. An integrated yellow gold Royal Oak bracelet with AP folding clasp completes the watch.

items.model: Cartier Pasha WGPA0007 Yellow Gold Silver-White Dial (2020)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Cartier Pasha  occupies a singular place in Cartier's catalog, tracing its origins to a 1943 commission from the Pasha of Marrakech — a sporty round wristwatch with the unusual ability to withstand swimming. Gérald Genta reinterpreted the design in 1985, transforming the original commission into a confident statement of distinctly Cartier sportiness, and the model was comprehensively revived in 2020. Its defining elements remain instantly recognizable: the secured screw-down crown cap attached to the case by a delicate chain, the four Arabic numerals at the cardinal positions, and the sapphire cabochon set within the crown. Reference WGPA0007 represents the large 41mm execution in 18-karat yellow gold, the most opulent metal expression of the current collection.

 The 41mm case in 18-karat yellow gold measures 9.55mm thick, distinguished by the chain-secured fluted crown cap with sapphire cabochon and a transparent sapphire caseback. The silvered flinqué dial carries the signature four black Arabic numerals at twelve, three, six, and nine, blued-steel sword hands, and a date aperture between four and five. The in-house automatic Caliber 1847 MC delivers approximately 48 hours of power reserve with magnetic resistance shielding, completed by Cartier's patented QuickSwitch system with two interchangeable alligator straps and yellow gold folding buckle.

 *This timepiece comes with two straps and the original white hang tag.

items.model: Richard Mille RM 35-02 'Rafa' Rafael Nadal Red Quartz TPT Diamond Set
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Richard Mille RM 35-02 'Rafa' Rafael Nadal Red Quartz TPT Diamond Set is a striking fusion of high-performance watchmaking and bold aesthetics, designed in tribute to tennis legend Rafael Nadal. Crafted from Red Quartz TPT, the case exhibits Richard Mille’s signature layered appearance—created by alternating layers of quartz fibers and resin, then compressed and machined to reveal a unique marbled texture in a vivid red hue. The bezel is set with brilliant-cut diamonds, dramatically contrasting with the sporty material to deliver a look that is both luxurious and technically avant-garde.

 Measuring 49.94 x 44.50 x 13.15mm, the case houses the Caliber RMAL1, a skeletonized automatic movement built with a grade 5 titanium baseplate and bridges for maximum rigidity and shock resistance. The movement features a variable-geometry rotor, which adjusts winding efficiency based on the wearer’s activity, and offers a 55-hour power reserve. The display showcases hours, minutes, and a central seconds hand, with a bold and openworked layout that celebrates the watch’s mechanical core.

 Paired with a composite strap, the RM 35-02 Red Quartz TPT Diamond Set is as eye-catching as it is durable—crafted for collectors who appreciate the fearless innovation of Richard Mille and the elite athletic legacy of Rafael Nadal. It’s a statement of power, precision, and exclusivity on the wrist.

items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
In 2022, Audemars Piguet marked fifty years of the  Royal Oak , the watch that rewrote the rules of luxury when Gérald Genta unveiled it in 1972. To commemorate the milestone, the manufacture released anniversary editions distinguished by a dedicated "50 Years" oscillating weight, a subtle badge of honor visible through the caseback. This 37mm reference captures the Royal Oak at its purest, celebrating half a century of an icon that transformed a steel sports watch into horological royalty.

 Crafted in stainless steel, the 37mm case retains the octagonal bezel and eight hexagonal screws that have defined the Royal Oak since the beginning, paired with the integrated bracelet. Its grey dial showcases the signature Grande Tapisserie pattern, a hand-guilloché grid that shimmers beneath applied white-gold markers and hands, with a date at three o'clock. A self-winding movement powers the watch, its commemorative rotor spinning behind a sapphire caseback inviting closer admiration.

The RM 010 holds a special place as one of Richard Mille's foundational models, the accessible everyday automatic that introduced many collectors to the brand's radical vision. It distills the maison's philosophy, extreme engineering treated like Formula 1 technology, into a versatile time-and-date watch built for daily wear. Rendered in warm rose gold, this example softens the brand's usual techno-aggression with a touch of classic luxury. Enthusiasts prize it as the definitive entry-level Richard Mille grail.

 The tonneau case, at 48 mm x 39.30 mm, is crafted in 18-karat rose gold, its three-part construction secured by Richard Mille's exposed spline screws. Behind the curved crystal, the skeletonized automatic movement is laid bare, its bridges and gears floating against open space, with applied white Arabic numerals ringing the perimeter. Slim white hands mark the time above an oversized date at six. The variable-geometry rotor drives it efficiently, all mounted on a white rubber strap, sporty yet refined.

items.model: Richard Mille RM 67-02 'Mutaz Barshim' Quartz TPT
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Richard Mille RM 67-02 ‘Mutaz Barshim’ is a featherweight marvel created in collaboration with Olympic high jump champion Mutaz Essa Barshim. Designed for extreme athletic performance, the watch is a tribute to both cutting-edge materials and high-level sports engineering. The Quartz TPT case, rendered in a vibrant combination of Burgundy and White, reflects the colors of Barshim’s home country, Qatar, while also highlighting Richard Mille’s signature layered carbon aesthetic.

 Measuring 47.52 x 38.70 x 7.80mm, the ultra-thin tonneau case is crafted entirely from Quartz TPT—an advanced composite that’s not only extremely lightweight but also highly shock-resistant. Weighing just 32 grams including the strap, it’s one of the lightest mechanical watches ever made. The skeletonized CRMA7 automatic movement, built from grade 5 titanium, is visible through both the front and back sapphire crystals and features a variable-geometry rotor optimized for active wear.

 Fitted with a comfort elastic strap, the RM 67-02 Mutaz Barshim offers a seamless, ergonomic fit ideal for elite athletes. With its fusion of innovation, bold aesthetics, and unparalleled lightness, this watch exemplifies Richard Mille’s philosophy of building “a racing machine on the wrist”—engineered for champions who defy gravity.

items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The 5726A-001 expanded the  Nautilus into more complicated territory when it debuted in 2010, marrying Gérald Genta's iconic 1976 sports design with Patek Philippe's patented annual calendar. The annual calendar itself — a Patek invention of 1996 — represents one of the maison's signature contributions to modern watchmaking, automatically accounting for months of thirty and thirty-one days while requiring correction only once a year. For collectors, the reference offers a compelling balance: the everyday wearability and unmistakable identity of the Nautilus combined with a genuinely useful complication, executed in steel and offered on a leather strap rather than the familiar integrated bracelet.

 The 40.5mm case in stainless steel measures 11.3mm thick, retaining the signature rounded octagonal bezel with alternating satin and polished finishes. The sunburst charcoal grey dial with black-gradient rim carries horizontal embossing, white gold applied baton markers, and luminescent hands, with day, date, and month apertures beneath twelve and a combined moon phase and 24-hour subdial at six. The self-winding Caliber 324 S QA LU 24H/303, visible through the sapphire caseback, delivers a 45-hour power reserve, completed by a black alligator strap with fold-over deployant clasp.

 *This timepiece comes with a stylus.

items.model: Rolex Daytona 116508 Yellow Gold Meteorite Dial
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Daytona traces to 1963, when Rolex conceived it as a professional racing chronograph and named it for the Florida circuit that had become synonymous with high-speed endurance competition. Reference 116508 represents the previous-generation full yellow gold Daytona, but this particular execution was introduced at Baselworld 2021 as part of a trio of "meteorite panda" configurations that elevated the model into rarefied territory. The dial is sliced from the Gibeon meteorite — discovered near the Namibian town in 1836 — whose distinctive Widmanstätten crystalline pattern formed over millions of years in space, ensuring every example remains genuinely one of a kind. The reference has since been superseded by the current-generation 126508, adding collectibility to this specific execution.

 The 40mm case in 18-karat yellow gold features a fixed engraved tachymeter bezel and Triplock screw-down crown with matching chronograph pushers. The meteorite dial carries three contrasting black subdials in a reverse-panda configuration, red "Daytona" text above six o'clock echoing vintage examples, yellow gold applied index markers with Chromalight luminescence, and yellow gold hands. The in-house automatic Caliber 4130 — a self-winding chronograph with column wheel and vertical clutch — delivers a 72-hour power reserve, completed by an 18-karat yellow gold Oyster bracelet with Oysterlock folding safety clasp.

items.sourceDescription:
The Patek Philippe Nautilus 7118/1200R-001 represents Patek Philippe's luxurious interpretation of the iconic Nautilus collection designed by Gérald Genta in 1976, scaled to 35.2mm to suit feminine wrists while maintaining the distinctive porthole-inspired octagonal bezel and horizontally embossed dial pattern that has defined the collection for nearly five decades. This reference elevates the sporty elegance characteristic of the Nautilus through factory-set diamond bezel totaling significant carat weight and rose gold case construction, creating a timepiece that transitions seamlessly from casual to formal occasions while maintaining the water resistance and robust build quality expected from one of the most coveted collections in haute horlogologie. The combination of rose gold warmth with silvery-white dial creates sophisticated color harmony, appealing to collectors who value both the revolutionary integrated bracelet sports watch design that challenged watchmaking conventions in the 1970s and the refined femininity achieved through precious materials and gem-setting craftsmanship combined with current-production availability.

 The 35.2mm case crafted in 18-karat rose gold features the signature Nautilus octagonal bezel set with approximately 46 brilliant-cut diamonds, polished surfaces on bezel top and case flanks contrasting with brushed case band, characteristic hinged lugs integrated seamlessly into bracelet design, sapphire crystal, and transparent sapphire caseback revealing the decorated movement. The silvery-white dial displays applied luminous rose gold baton hour markers at all positions except 3 o'clock where the date window resides, polished rose gold baton hands with luminous fill, horizontal embossed pattern characteristic of Nautilus dials creating subtle texture and light play across the surface, black printed minute track along outer edge, and date display at 3 o'clock with white background matching the overall aesthetic. Inside beats the self-winding Caliber 324 S C featuring central rotor in 21-karat gold, 29 jewels, Gyromax balance wheel, Spiromax balance spring in Silinvar silicon, frequency of 28,800 vibrations per hour, Patek Philippe Seal certification guaranteeing exceptional finishing and precision standards of minus three to plus two seconds per day, approximately 35 to 45 hours of power reserve. Rose gold integrated Nautilus bracelet with polished center links and brushed outer links secures with fold-over clasp.

The Patek Philippe Golden Ellipse 5738P-001 represents Patek Philippe's contemporary interpretation of the Golden Ellipse collection introduced in 1968 as a bold departure from traditional round watch design, conceived during an era of horological innovation when manufacturers explored unconventional case shapes inspired by mathematical principles and artistic movements. The Golden Ellipse derives its distinctive cushion-shaped case from the golden ratio of 1 to 1.6181 considered by ancient Greek mathematicians and Renaissance artists to represent perfect aesthetic harmony, creating an elegantly elongated profile that has remained essentially unchanged for over five decades demonstrating the timelessness of pure geometric design. This reference combines the classical Golden Ellipse silhouette with platinum construction and striking blue sunburst dial finish, appealing to collectors who value both mathematical elegance and understated luxury combined with Patek Philippe's legendary movement finishing standards and current-production availability backed by comprehensive warranty coverage through the manufacture's global service network.

 The 34.5mm x 39.5mm elliptical case crafted in platinum features polished bezel with perfectly proportioned golden ratio dimensions, polished case flanks, sapphire crystal, and solid platinum caseback with subtle finish. The blue sunburst dial displays applied white gold baton hour markers at all positions creating clean minimalist aesthetic, white gold baton hands, subtle sunburst finish emanating from center creating radial pattern with dynamic light play across blue surface, no additional complications or text beyond "Patek Philippe Genève" maintaining pure elegance through restraint. Inside beats the manual-winding Caliber 240 featuring ultra-thin construction at just 2.53mm height allowing remarkably slender overall case profile, off-center micro-rotor would typically be present in automatic version but this manual-winding variant maintains traditional winding crown operation, 27 jewels, Gyromax balance wheel, Spiromax balance spring in Silinvar silicon, frequency of 21,600 vibrations per hour, Patek Philippe Seal certification guaranteeing exceptional finishing standards and precision of minus three to plus two seconds per day, approximately 48 hours of power reserve. Hand-stitched navy blue alligator leather strap with large square scales secures with platinum pin buckle.

 *This timepiece comes with the original hang tag.

items.model: Audemars Piguet Royal Oak 16202ST.OO.1240ST.02 'Jumbo' Extra-Thin Stainless Steel Blue Dial (2025)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Royal Oak Jumbo ' Extra-Thin represents the most historically resonant reference in the entire collection — the direct modern descendant of Gérald Genta's foundational 1972 Reference 5402, the watch that established the luxury steel sports watch category and redefined watchmaking. Reference 16202ST maintains the original's 39mm proportions and 8.1mm ultra-thin profile alongside the signature "Bleu Nuit, Nuage 50" dial — a color reproducing the deep blue that Stern created for the original 1972 model, where pigment number 50 was added to protective Zapon varnish. Introduced with the new in-house Caliber 7121 replacing the legendary Caliber 2121 that powered the Jumbo for fifty years, this reference stands as the most faithful contemporary expression of the model that defined an entire genre.

 The 39mm case in stainless steel measures just 8.1mm thick, framed by the signature octagonal bezel with eight hexagonal screws, screw-locked crown, and exhibition sapphire caseback. The "Bleu Nuit, Nuage 50" dial carries the "Petite Tapisserie" pattern — a finer-scale rendition of the signature texture — with white gold applied hour markers, Royal Oak hands with luminescent coating, and date at three. The in-house automatic Caliber 7121 delivers a 55-hour power reserve at 4 Hz, completed by an integrated stainless steel Royal Oak bracelet with AP folding clasp.

items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
This Rolex Datejust 31 represents Rolex's dedication to creating elegant timepieces sized specifically for smaller wrists, continuing the legacy established by the original Datejust in 1945 as the world's first self-winding waterproof chronometer wristwatch with automatically changing date display. The reference 278273 combines the prestige of two-tone construction in what Rolex designates as Yellow Rolesor with contemporary dial artistry, offering the highly sought-after olive green sunburst finish adorned with factory-set brilliant-cut diamond hour markers that has become one of the most in-demand configurations for women's luxury watches. As a current-production model backed by Rolex's comprehensive warranty and global service network, this Datejust 31 offers modern reliability while maintaining the classic proportions and design language that have defined the collection for nearly eight decades, appealing to collectors who value understated elegance with refined diamond embellishments and contemporary color palettes.

 The 31mm case crafted in stainless steel and 18-karat yellow gold features the monobloc middle case construction with screw-down caseback and winding crown employing the Twinlock double waterproofness system ensuring 100 meters of water resistance. The fluted bezel crafted in solid 18-karat yellow gold frames the striking olive green sunburst dial adorned with ten brilliant-cut diamond hour markers at all positions except 3 o'clock where the date window resides, polished yellow gold hands, and the instantaneous date display at 3 o'clock sits beneath a scratch-resistant sapphire crystal with Cyclops lens magnifying the date 2.5 times for easy reading. Inside beats the manufacture Rolex Caliber 2236 featuring the Syloxi hairspring in silicon with patented geometry, high-performance Paraflex shock absorbers, bidirectional self-winding via Perpetual rotor, Superlative Chronometer certification with precision of minus two to plus two seconds per day after casing, 31 jewels, frequency of 28,800 vibrations per hour, and approximately 55 hours of power reserve. The five-piece link Jubilee bracelet in stainless steel and yellow gold with polished and brushed surfaces secures with the Oysterclasp folding clasp featuring Easylink 5mm comfort extension link.

 *This timepiece comes with the original hang tag.

items.model: Richard Mille RM 004-V3 'Asia Edition' Carbon-TPT Rose Gold Limited Edition of 15 (2019)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The RM 004 occupies foundational status within Richard Mille's chronograph catalog — introduced in 2005 following five years of research and development, representing the manufacture's mastery of the split-seconds (rattrapante) chronograph, one of the most complex traditional complications in watchmaking. Its column-wheel construction with improved split-seconds mechanism virtually eliminated the unpredictable jumping of the seconds hand that afflicted other split-seconds chronographs. The "Asia Edition" configuration in Carbon TPT with 18-karat rose gold accents represents one of the rarest RM 004 executions ever produced — limited to just fifteen pieces created exclusively for the Asian market, placing it among Richard Mille's most exclusive and geographically restricted references.

 The 42mm x 50mm tonneau case in Carbon TPT — the brand's layered carbon nanofiber composite with distinctive striated appearance — measures 16.5mm thick and features polished 18-karat rose gold pushpieces and crown accents alongside sapphire crystal front and exhibition caseback. The fully skeletonized dial reveals the movement architecture with rose gold-tone Arabic numerals, two chronograph subdials, power reserve indicator, torque indicator, function indicator, and inner rose gold tachymeter bezel. The hand-wound Caliber RM 004-V3 — a split-seconds chronograph with 30-minute totalizer built on a grade-5 titanium baseplate — delivers approximately 70 hours of power reserve, completed by a black rubber strap.

 *This watch is a limited edition of 15 pieces.

The Richard Mille RM 035  'Ultimate Edition' is a highly coveted and ultra-lightweight timepiece that pushes the boundaries of high-performance watchmaking. Crafted entirely in Carbon TPT®, this limited edition release serves as the final chapter of the RM 035 line—originally developed in collaboration with tennis champion Rafael Nadal. The bridges and baseplate are crafted in grade 5 titanium, and the overall architecture is engineered for maximum visibility and mechanical integrity.

 Worn on a black rubber strap with a matching Carbon TPT buckle, the RM 035 Ultimate Edition is not just a farewell to a groundbreaking series, but a celebration of what Richard Mille does best: ultra-light materials, skeletonized engineering, and elite-level exclusivity. A true collector’s piece, designed for those who appreciate both innovation and the art of performance.

White gold pointed hands complete the dial. The President bracelet in white gold with concealed Crownclasp completes the reference. Caliber 3255 powers the movement.

items.sourceDescription:
The reference 26420 series represents a significant evolution for the  Royal Oak Offshore chronograph line, introduced in 2022 with a redesigned 43mm case specifically engineered to accommodate the new manufacture Caliber 4401. This marks a departure from previous Offshore chronographs that utilized modified base movements, as the 4401 features fully integrated chronograph architecture with column-wheel control and flyback function. The smoked taupe variant (reference 26420SO.OO.A600CA.01) offers a sophisticated color treatment rarely seen in sports chronographs, with graduated tones transitioning from light brown at the center to darker edges across the signature Méga Tapisserie pattern. The 26420 also introduces refined subdial positioning and updated proportions compared to earlier 42mm Offshore chronographs, creating better visual balance while maintaining the collection's bold, muscular presence established since the Offshore's 1993 debut.

 The 43mm stainless steel case measures 14.4mm thick with octagonal architecture secured by eight hexagonal screws across the black ceramic bezel. Sandblasted stainless steel pushpiece guards flank the black ceramic chronograph pushers and screw-locked crown. Glareproofed sapphire crystals protect both dial and exhibition caseback. The smoked light brown dial showcases the new-generation Méga Tapisserie waffle pattern with black chronograph counters at 3, 6, and 9 o'clock positioned against black outer zone. White gold applied hour markers and Royal Oak hands feature luminescent coating. Black inner bezel displays tachymeter scale, date window positioned at 4:30. Manufacture Caliber 4401 automatic integrated chronograph features column-wheel mechanism with flyback function, operating at 28,800 vph with 40 jewels, 367 components, and 70-hour power reserve. Light brown rubber strap with interchangeable strap system and stainless steel AP pin buckle, includes additional black rubber strap, 100-meter water resistance.

*This timepiece comes with the original hang tag and an additional strap.

Caliber 5800, self-winding with approximately 55-hour power reserve, powers the movement.

items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Patek Philippe Grand Complications 5496P-015 is a timeless masterpiece of horological innovation and elegance, combining a perpetual calendar and moon phases in an ultra-luxurious platinum case. The 39.5mm polished platinum case features subtle details, including a diamond set between the lugs at 6 o’clock—a hallmark of Patek Philippe’s platinum watches.

 The silver opaline dial exudes refinement, with applied gold hour markers and elegant dauphine hands ensuring legibility. The perpetual calendar is showcased through retrograde date functionality, with apertures for the day and month at 12 o’clock and a moon phase display at 6 o’clock. The layout is both intricate and harmonious, underscoring the technical prowess behind this complication.

items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
Among Patek Philippe's  grand complications , the 5208 occupies a rarefied summit: it was the manufacture's first self-winding wristwatch to unite three of horology's most demanding disciplines in a single automatic movement. Reserved for the brand's most accomplished collectors and produced in the barest numbers, it represents the pinnacle of Patek's Grand Complications catalogue. The rose gold 5208R-001, with its dramatic black dial, translates that technical bravado into an object of restrained, almost understated seriousness that only the initiated fully grasp.

 Housed in a 42mm rose gold case, the black dial orchestrates an extraordinary density of information without confusion. A minute repeater chimes the time on demand, while a single-button chronograph and a perpetual calendar unfold across the face. Apertures for day, date, and month occupy the upper dial, registers track elapsed time and the calendar, and a moon phase glows within the subsidiary seconds, all framed by applied gold markers.

 *This model was discontinued in 2025.

items.sourceDescription:
Patek Philippe rarely makes watches in stainless steel, and rarer still are its pilot's watches, making the  Calatrava Pilot 5522A one of the most coveted modern Pateks. Created in a limited run of 600 for the maison's 2017 Grand Exhibition in New York, it descends from Patek's little-known 1930s aviation watches, reviving that heritage in bold, legible form. Its combination of a steel case, a striking blue dial, and rarity turned it into a collector's grail.

 The 42mm stainless steel case is polished to a shine, its clean lines and simple lugs keeping the focus on the dial. That blue dial prioritizes aviator legibility, with oversized white Arabic numerals, a printed minute track, and bold pilot-style hands. A thin central seconds hand sweeps above, driven by a self-winding movement. There is no date, nothing to break the symmetry. A brown calf leather strap with contrast stitching completes its vintage-military spirit.

 *This is a limited edition of 600 pieces.

 *This timepiece comes with the original hang tag.

items.sourceDescription:
The Audemars Piguet Royal Oak 15407OR.OO.1220OR.01 is a visually commanding take on the brand’s groundbreaking double balance wheel architecture, crafted entirely in 18k rose gold and paired with a dramatic openworked dial. Measuring 41mm, the case showcases the Royal Oak’s iconic features—octagonal bezel with eight white gold screws, integrated bracelet, and a seamless mix of brushed and polished surfaces that highlight the warmth and richness of the rose gold.

 At the heart of this reference is the Caliber 3132, a manually decorated selfwinding movement featuring twin balance wheels and double hairsprings mounted on the same axis, a patented innovation that enhances accuracy and stability by synchronizing their oscillations. The openworked bridges are rendered in a contrasting dark slate grey, exposing the mechanics of the gear train, barrel, and dual balance wheels with symmetrical precision. The sapphire caseback reveals more of the movement's high-end finishing, including polished angles and Côtes de Genève.

 With its high-horology engineering and full precious metal construction, the 15407OR.OO.1220OR.01 is a bold expression of both technical mastery and aesthetic refinement—making it a centerpiece for collectors drawn to the mechanical soul of the Royal Oak.

items.model: Audemars Piguet Royal Oak 16202BA.OO.1240BA.02 'Jumbo' Extra-Thin Yellow Gold (2025)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The  Royal Oak 16202BA represents the contemporary evolution of Audemars Piguet's most iconic design, maintaining the beloved Jumbo proportions that defined Gérald Genta's revolutionary 1972 original reference 5402 while incorporating the latest manufacture movement technology. Introduced in 2022 as the successor to the 50th Anniversary model, this reference continues the legacy of the extra-thin Royal Oak Jumbo showcasing Audemars Piguet's mastery in creating ultra-thin automatic movements while preserving the architectural purity and balanced proportions that made the original Jumbo a legend. The smoked yellow gold-toned dial with gradient effect creates stunning visual depth that shifts dramatically depending on lighting conditions, offering collectors the warm aesthetic of precious metal execution combined with contemporary dial artistry, appealing to those who appreciate understated luxury with heritage significance in current production form backed by Audemars Piguet's comprehensive warranty and global service network.

 The 39mm case crafted in 18-karat yellow gold features the iconic octagonal bezel secured by eight polished hexagonal screws in white gold, brushed surfaces with polished beveled edges creating dynamic interplay of finishes, integrated case construction with screwed caseback, glare-proofed sapphire crystal and exhibition sapphire caseback revealing the meticulously finished automatic movement. The smoked yellow gold-toned dial displays the signature Petite Tapisserie pattern with gradient effect transitioning from lighter center to darker periphery, applied polished yellow gold baton hour markers with luminescent coating, yellow gold Royal Oak hands with luminescent coating, fine printed minute track, and date window at 3 o'clock. Inside beats the self-winding Caliber 7121 manufactured entirely in-house featuring ultra-thin construction at 3.4mm height, 18-karat rose gold skeletonized rotor, 33 jewels, 268 components, frequency of 28,800 vibrations per hour, and approximately 52 hours of power reserve. Integrated 18-karat yellow gold bracelet with brushed surfaces and polished beveled edges secured with AP folding clasp.

items.model: Patek Philippe Nautilus 3710/1A-001 'Jumbo' Power Reserve Indicator Stainless Steel Black Dial
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Patek Philippe  Nautilus 3710/1A-001 is a milestone reference within the Nautilus lineage, introduced in 1998 as the first model in the collection to feature a complication beyond time and date. Its 40 mm stainless steel “Jumbo” case retains the porthole-inspired design and integrated bracelet that define the Nautilus, while its black dial departs from the signature horizontal embossing in favor of a smooth lacquered finish. Applied Roman numerals and luminous hands lend balance, while a fan-shaped power reserve indicator at 12 o’clock adds both visual intrigue and functional utility.

 Powered by the automatic Caliber 330 SC IZR, this reference was produced until 2006, giving it a relatively short production span compared to other Nautilus models. Its rarity, combined with its unique dial configuration, has elevated it into a highly sought-after collectible. The 3710/1A-001 remains prized as a transitional reference that marries Nautilus sport-luxury DNA with the discreet addition of horological complexity.

items.model: Audemars Piguet Royal Oak 15202BA.OO.1240BA.01 'Jumbo' Extra Thin Yellow Gold Blue Dial (2018)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
Few watches are as  historically significant as the Royal Oak "Jumbo," the direct descendant of the original 1972 model that Gérald Genta designed to save Audemars Piguet and, in doing so, invented the luxury steel sports watch. The 15202 preserves the founding blueprint untouched: the same slim proportions, the same integrated bracelet, the same defiant silhouette. Discontinued in 2022, it has become the most coveted reference in the modern collection, revered by purists as the truest Royal Oak of all. 

 Rendered entirely in 18-karat yellow gold, the slim 39mm case wears the octagonal bezel secured by eight hexagonal screws. The blue dial carries the signature Petite Tapisserie pattern, a waffled guilloché that shifts with the light beneath applied gold markers and hands. A date sits at three o'clock, and the ultra-thin automatic movement lets the watch slip beneath a cuff, uniting case and bracelet into one continuous flow of gold.

items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The 26401RO arrived in 2019 as the rose gold flagship of Audemars Piguet's revived camouflage Royal Oak Offshore series, succeeding the 2018 "Combat" reference that first introduced military aesthetics to the 44mm Offshore line. Released as a boutique-exclusive limited edition of just 500 pieces, it sat alongside two 400-piece stainless steel companions in blue and khaki green, but distinguished itself as the only rose gold variant of the trio. The interplay between warm 18-karat rose gold, brown ceramic, and the desert camouflage strap created a tonal cohesion that resonated with collectors drawn to the Offshore's bolder expressions while preserving the precious-metal pedigree at the core of the model.

 The 44mm case in 18-karat rose gold measures 14.4mm thick, framed by a brown ceramic bezel with rose gold pushpiece guards and ceramic crown. The brown "Méga Tapisserie" dial carries three rose gold chronograph counters at twelve, nine, and six, white luminescent applied markers and hands, red chronograph accents, and a date aperture at three. The in-house automatic Caliber 3126/3840 — wound by a 22-karat gold rotor and visible through the sapphire caseback — delivers a 50-hour power reserve, completed by a brown camouflage rubber strap with rose gold pin buckle.

 *Limited Edition of 500 pieces.

items.model: Richard Mille RM 037 'Ladies' Rose Gold Carbon TPT Diamond Set Skeleton Dial
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Richard Mille RM 037  is Richard Mille's dedicated ladies' automatic — a watch that applies the manufacture's full engineering vocabulary of aerospace-derived materials and skeletonized movement architecture to a tonneau case scaled for smaller wrists without reducing either technical ambition or visual intensity. The Carbon TPT case represents one of Richard Mille's most distinctive material achievements: a composite constructed from hundreds of carbon fibre layers laid at 45-degree alternating angles and infused with a proprietary resin, producing a surface with a characteristic rippled grain that is simultaneously among the lightest and most structurally rigid case materials in watchmaking. The combination of Carbon TPT with rose gold crown, pushers, and movement accents — and with vertical rows of pavé-set diamonds running the full length of the case — positions this example at the intersection of extreme materials engineering and haute joaillerie, a territory Richard Mille has made distinctly its own.

 The Carbon TPT tonneau case carries rose gold crown and pushers, with vertical rows of round brilliant-cut diamonds set across the case flanks and integrated strap lugs. The skeletonized dial reveals the automatic movement beneath a pavé diamond-set oval shield surround in rose gold, with rose gold hands, a date aperture at twelve, and a function selector at three o'clock. The movement architecture — bridges, gears, and mainspring barrel — is fully visible through the open dial. A white rubber strap completes the reference.

items.sourceDescription:
The  RM 65-01 is the most complicated automatic Richard Mille has ever built in-house, a tour de force centred on a split-seconds chronograph that times two events at once. Beyond that rattrapante function, it offers rapid winding at the push of a button and a crown-mounted function selector for setting modes, all driven by an exceptionally fast movement. Rendered here in full rose gold, it trades the brand's usual composites for the warmth and heft of precious metal.

 The tonneau case is machined entirely from rose gold, its bezel and caseband secured by the signature spline screws. The midcase is made out of Carbon TPT. Behind the crystal, a densely skeletonised movement reveals its split-seconds mechanism, chronograph counters, and a date display, all rendered in a riot of colour against the openworked bridges. A cluster of dedicated pushers marked for seconds, winding, start-stop and reset rings the case, and a green rubber strap adds a final sporting flourish.

items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Richard Mille RM 029 Le Mans Classic in Green Quartz TPT® is a vibrant and ultra-exclusive edition created to celebrate the brand’s ongoing partnership with the legendary Le Mans Classic vintage endurance racing event. A tribute to motorsport heritage fused with cutting-edge materials, this limited edition stands out with a case crafted entirely from Green Quartz TPT®, featuring a unique layered texture formed by fusing hundreds of silica fibers with resin, then machined into Richard Mille’s signature tonneau-shaped silhouette.

 Measuring 48.15 x 39.69 x 13.10mm, the case offers both impressive wrist presence and exceptional wearability due to its light weight and ergonomic form. The dial is distinctly Richard Mille, with skeletonized architecture exposing the automatic Caliber RMAS7, which features a variable-geometry rotor, oversized date display at 4 o'clock, and a function selector allowing the crown to switch between winding, date, and hand-setting modes.

 Design details nod to the Le Mans Classic itself, including white racing stripes across the top of the case, a 24-hour marker in green to commemorate the race’s iconic format, and a white minute track for high legibility. Paired with a white vented rubber strap, the RM 029 Le Mans Classic Green Quartz TPT® is a striking fusion of innovation, motorsport culture, and high-horology craftsmanship—produced in an extremely limited series, making it a must-have for collectors who value exclusivity and performance-driven design.

 *Limited edition of 150 pieces.

items.model: Audemars Piguet Royal Oak 26317BC.OO.1256BC.01 Chronograph White Gold Light Blue Dial Limited Edition of 100 (2020)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Royal Oak Chronograph in "Ice Blue" represents one of the more refined boutique exclusives within Audemars Piguet's catalog, released in 2020 as a limited edition of just 100 pieces. Part of the Royal Oak Chronograph 38mm range introduced the previous year, the reference pairs Gérald Genta's iconic 1972 octagonal architecture with a delicate light blue "Grande Tapisserie" dial, executed entirely in 18-karat white gold. The pale dial creates a striking interplay of light against the white metal case and bracelet, while a contrasting dark blue external zone enhances legibility — a configuration that has made this discreet, monochromatic chronograph particularly coveted among collectors of precious-metal Royal Oaks.

 The 38mm case in 18-karat white gold measures 11mm thick, brushed with polished accents, its octagonal bezel secured beneath the signature hexagonal screws. The light blue "Grande Tapisserie" dial carries blue snailed counters within a darker blue outer ring, white gold applied hour markers, and luminescent Royal Oak hands, with three registers and a date aperture at four-thirty. The self-winding Caliber 2385, an integrated column-wheel chronograph with unidirectional solid gold rotor, delivers a 40-hour power reserve, completed by an integrated white gold Royal Oak bracelet with AP double-folding clasp.

*This watch is a limited edition of 100 pieces.

items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Overseas occupies an essential place in the history of the luxury steel sports watch, with design lineage tracing to the 1977 Vacheron Constantin 222 — the maison's 222nd-anniversary creation that stood alongside the Royal Oak and Nautilus as one of the era's defining integrated sports watches. Reference 4500V/110A-B128 launched at SIHH 2016 as the third generation of the modern Overseas, introducing the in-house Caliber 5100 and signature interchangeable strap system. Vacheron Constantin's status as the oldest continuously operating watch manufacture in the world — founded 1755 — combined with the movement's Geneva Hallmark certification places this reference among the most pedigreed contemporary luxury sports watches in production.

 The 41mm case in stainless steel measures 11mm thick, framed by the signature six-sided notched bezel inspired by the Maltese cross. The translucent blue lacquered dial with sunburst finish carries applied white gold markers, luminous silver hands, and a date aperture at three. The in-house automatic Caliber 5100 — visible through the sapphire caseback via its 22-karat gold wind-rose-inspired rotor — delivers a 60-hour power reserve and carries the Geneva Hallmark, completed by Vacheron's patented quick-release system with three interchangeable strap options: stainless steel bracelet, blue alligator leather, and blue rubber.

 *This timepiece comes with a stainless steel bracelet, rubber strap, and leather strap, as well as the original sales receipt and hang tag.

This silhouette lends the grand complication a warm, elegant character unlike the brand’s round offerings. Beneath its slim profile lies an ultra-thin self-winding movement driving a perpetual calendar, tracking the date, day, month, and leap-year without adjustment until 2100. In yellow gold, it embodies sophistication and Patek’s unrivalled horological pedigree.

 The cushion-shaped yellow gold 37 mm wide by 44.6 mm long case, with its rounded flanks and polished bezel, frames a silvered dial of warmth. Gold applied Arabic numerals ring the perimeter, while three subdials orchestrate the calendar: day with twenty-four-hour indication at nine, month with leap-year at three, and a pointer date encircling a moon-phase display at six. Gold hands sweep across the composition, and a brown alligator strap completes this union of complication and understated, vintage-flavoured charm.

items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Richard Mille RM 011 Felipe Massa Flyback Chronograph in black Carbon TPT is a bold and high-performance timepiece created in honor of Brazilian Formula 1 driver Felipe Massa, a longtime ambassador of the brand. This model exemplifies Richard Mille’s commitment to pushing the boundaries of horology through the use of ultra-lightweight materials, racing-inspired functionality, and technical mastery.

 The tonneau-shaped case, measuring approximately 50mm x 40mm, is crafted from Carbon TPT, a high-tech composite material composed of hundreds of layers of carbon fiber, compressed and machined into a unique marbled texture. This construction offers not only visual distinction but also exceptional durability and shock resistance—qualities essential in the world of motorsport.

 At the heart of the watch is the automatic RMAC1 caliber, featuring a flyback chronograph, annual calendar, oversized date, and UTC function. The skeletonized dial reveals the intricate mechanics beneath, including the variable geometry rotor, which adapts winding efficiency based on the wearer’s activity level. The chronograph pushers and crown are designed for high functionality and ergonomic use, even under intense conditions.

 Fitted with a rubber strap for maximum comfort and sportiness, the RM 011 Felipe Massa Carbon TPT is a true “racing machine on the wrist”—a tribute to speed, precision, and innovation, engineered for collectors who demand cutting-edge technology in every detail.

items.model: Patek Philippe Complications 5235/50R-001 Annual Calendar Regulator Display Rose Gold Gray Dial
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Patek Philippe Complications 5235/50R-001 represents Patek Philippe's innovative fusion of the annual calendar complication with the classical regulator dial layout displaying hours, minutes, and seconds on separate axes rather than concentrically, introduced in 2011 as the first regulator-style display combined with annual calendar functionality in the manufacture's history spanning over 180 years. This reference revives the 18th-century precision regulator clock tradition where watchmakers used separate indications to minimize visual interference when reading time with maximum accuracy, adapted for modern wrist wear while incorporating the annual calendar mechanism automatically accounting for months of varying lengths requiring manual correction only once per year on March 1st following February. The distinctive off-center layout creates asymmetrical visual interest contrasting with traditional centered dial architecture, appealing to collectors who value both historical horological traditions reimagined for contemporary watchmaking and technical complications combined with unconventional aesthetic expression characteristic of Patek Philippe's willingness to innovate within classical framework.

 The 40.5mm case crafted in 18-karat rose gold features polished round bezel, brushed case band, straight lugs with polished surfaces, sapphire crystal, recessed correctors in case band for independent adjustment of day, date, and month, and transparent sapphire caseback revealing the meticulously finished movement. The gray sunburst dial displays off-center regulator layout with large minutes subdial occupying upper two-thirds of dial featuring applied rose gold baton markers and minute track with printed divisions, small hours subdial at 6 o'clock with rose gold baton markers, small seconds subdial at 9 o'clock, day display in aperture at 10 o'clock, date display in aperture at 4 o'clock integrated into minutes subdial perimeter, month display in aperture at 8 o'clock, all subsidiary displays arranged asymmetrically following regulator tradition, rose gold hands throughout. Inside beats the self-winding Caliber 31-260 REG QA featuring annual calendar mechanism with instantaneous jump for all calendar indications, regulator gear train configuration separating hours and minutes on different axes, central rotor in 21-karat gold, 34 jewels, Gyromax balance wheel, Spiromax balance spring in Silinvar silicon, frequency of 28,800 vibrations per hour, Patek Philippe Seal certification guaranteeing exceptional finishing and precision standards of minus three to plus two seconds per day, approximately 38 to 48 hours of power reserve. Hand-stitched brown alligator leather strap with large square scales secures with 18-karat rose gold fold-over clasp.

items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
This Royal Oak Chronograph in rose gold represents the reference in its most classically luxurious expression — Genta's sport-watch architecture reinterpreted through a precious metal that amplifies the case's sculptural geometry rather than subverting it. Reference 26320OR, produced in 41mm, succeeded the long-running 26022OR and introduced caliber 2385 before the subsequent generation upgrade, placing it at a meaningful transitional moment in Royal Oak chronograph history. Rose gold Royal Oak chronographs on leather straps remain among the most versatile configurations in the family, equally at home across formal and casual contexts in ways that bracelet variants cannot match.

 The 41mm rose gold case presents the signature octagonal bezel secured by eight brushed steel screws, with alternating polished and brushed surface finishing across the lugs and case flanks. The silver "Grande Tapisserie" dial carries three chronograph subdials — twelve-hour register at nine, thirty-minute counter at twelve, and running seconds at six — with a date aperture at four-thirty, all complemented by rose gold-toned baton indexes and matching hands. A dark brown alligator leather strap with rose gold deployant clasp completes the configuration.

 *This timepiece comes with the original hang tag.

items.model: Richard Mille RM 011 Felipe Massa Chronograph Rose Gold Titanium
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The  RM 011 occupies foundational status within Richard Mille's catalog. Launched in 2007 as the manufacture's first flyback chronograph, it was developed in collaboration with Ferrari Formula 1 driver Felipe Massa and became the commercial bedrock that established Richard Mille as a force in modern haute horology. Production continued for a decade before the RM 011 was succeeded by the RM 11-03 in 2017, making the original Felipe Massa references increasingly difficult to source on the secondary market. The rose gold and titanium execution remains among the most coveted configurations, balancing the warmth of precious metal with the brand's signature engineering ethos.

 The tripartite tonneau case measures 50 x 40 x 16.15mm with 18-karat rose gold bezel and caseback flanking a grade-5 titanium midcase, secured by titanium spline screws. The skeletonized dial reveals the automatic Caliber RMAC1 with flyback chronograph, 60-minute countdown at nine, small seconds at three, 12-hour totalizer at six, oversized date at twelve, and month aperture at four-thirty. Crafted entirely in grade-5 titanium, the movement features a variable-geometry rotor and delivers 50 hours of reserve, completed by a black rubber strap with titanium deployant clasp.
