items.model: Urwerk 100 SpaceTime GunMetal UR 100 GM
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
Introducing the Urwerk Space Time Gunmetal UR-100 the in titanium and stainless-steel. It includes a carbon-fiber strap with a PVD coated titanium tang buckle and scratch resistant sapphire crystals (domed on the dial). It has a pull out winding crown at the top of the case at 12 o'clock, knurled case band sections, and there is an exhibition sapphire display case back secured with 4 screws and it's engraved with "TIGA14V/316L – SWISS MADE – LIMITED EDITION 25 PCS," and a serial number. The 41mm by 49.7mm barrel-shaped solid three-body case, straight lugs, and flat bezel have a PVD Gun Metal finish. The dial is skeletonized with matte grey and gun metal bridges and besides showing the time this special astronomical watch exhibits the number of kilometers the Earth has rotated each day at the equator, created by French clockmaker Gustave Sandoz with a pendulum that beats once every 2.16 seconds – equal to a distance of rotation of 500 meters. There are three different hour discs on a central carrier that rotate clockwise across a black arc with luminous green Super LumiNova Arabic numerals and markers at the lower half of the dial with the minutes indicated by a red arrow with a white luminous inset acting as a minute hand. The active hour is indicated with a red pointer. There are two sectors in the upper half of the dial with an orbital satellite display with wandering hours and minutes; the left-side arch between 9 and 10 o'clock shows the number of kilometers that the Earth has rotated at the equator over a 20-minute period up to a total of 555 kilometers. The arch on the right side between 2 and 3 o'clock shows how many kilometers that the Earth has traveled along its orbit for a total of 35,740k every 20-minutes. It has a 48-hour power reserve at full winding, it's water resistant and pressure tested to 30 meters/100 feet, and the 14mm thick case, dial, and movement are all signed. This Urwerk Space Time Gunmetal UR-100 has a mechanical automatic self-winding Urwerk caliber UR-12.01 movement. It has a "Windfanger" airscrew that resembles a propeller that regulates the rotor reducing shock. The mechanism oscillates at a frequency of 28,800 vph (4Hz).

items.model: Richard Mille RM 33-02 Carbon-TPT Rose Gold Limited Edition of 140
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The RM 33-02 occupies a distinctive position within Richard Mille's catalog as the brand's first round automatic timepiece executed in Carbon TPT. Launched in 2019 as the successor to the RM 033 (2011) and RM 33-01 (2015), it carries forward the manufacture's ultra-thin round design language while introducing the proprietary composite material to the form. Limited to 140 pieces worldwide, the reference reinterprets the original aesthetic by combining tonneau-derived curves with a circular silhouette, distinguished by signature indentations at six and twelve o'clock that integrate the lugs directly into the case's torque-screw system — a hallmark of the model rarely encountered in round watchmaking.

 The tripartite case measures 41.70 x 8.80mm with Carbon TPT bezel and caseback flanking a satin-finished 18-karat 5N rose gold midcase, secured by fourteen grade-5 titanium spline screws. The skeletonized dial features applied rose gold Arabic numerals on titanium rails over a rose gold flange. The automatic Caliber RMXP1 — built in grade-5 titanium with Titalyt treatment and just 2.6mm thick — is wound by an off-center monoblock platinum micro-rotor and delivers a 45-hour power reserve, completed by a black rubber strap with rose gold deployant clasp.

 *This watch is a limited edition of 140 pieces.

items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Calatrava Pilot Travel Time  occupies a singular position in the Patek Philippe catalog — the manufacture's most direct engagement with aviation-inspired design vocabulary applied to one of its most storied case families. Reference 7234G-001, the white gold iteration in 38mm, carries particular collector significance as the smaller of the two Pilot Travel Time expressions, making it among the rare Patek Philippe complications equally suited to a broad range of wrists. Production in white gold at this diameter is tightly constrained through authorized channels, and the reference consistently draws collectors who seek genuine complication depth within an understated sporting aesthetic.

 The 38mm white gold case presents a cushion-influenced round profile with two lateral correctors for advancing and retarding the local hour hand independently of the home time display. The deep blue dial carries large luminous Arabic numerals and a lower subdial combining a 24-hour home time indicator with date display, labeled distinctly "Local" and "Home." Oversized luminous hands in matching blue and cream tones ensure immediate legibility. A navy blue calfskin leather strap with white contrast stitching completes the reference.

 *This model was discontinued in 2024.

items.model: Rolex Sky-Dweller 326938 Yellow Gold White Dial (2022)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Rolex Sky-Dweller 326938 represents Rolex's most sophisticated complication combining annual calendar automatically accounting for months of varying lengths requiring manual correction only once per year on March 1st with dual time zone display through innovative Saros system named after the astronomical cycle, introduced in 2012 as Rolex's first new collection launch since the Yacht-Master debut in 1992. The Sky-Dweller showcases Ring Command bezel technology allowing all calendar and GMT functions to be set through the winding crown by rotating the bezel to select which function to adjust, eliminating the need for additional pushers or correctors and maintaining the clean case profile characteristic of Rolex design philosophy. Engineered specifically for frequent travelers navigating multiple time zones while maintaining home time reference, this reference appeals to collectors who value practical complications combined with Rolex's reputation for reliability, robust construction, and comprehensive global service network supporting current-production models.

 The 42mm case crafted in 18-karat yellow gold features fluted bidirectional Ring Command bezel serving as interface for function selection when combined with winding crown, polished case flanks, screw-down Twinlock crown with double waterproofness system ensuring 100 meters of water resistance, sapphire crystal with Cyclops lens magnifying the date 2.5 times, and screw-down caseback. The white dial displays applied yellow gold stick hour markers, yellow gold Mercedes-style hour and minute hands, off-center 24-hour disc at 6 o'clock with rotating red triangle indicator showing home time in second time zone, 12 month indicators positioned around perimeter of dial with current month highlighted by small rectangular aperture, instantaneous date display at 3 o'clock with white background beneath Cyclops magnification, all calendar and GMT indications legible at a glance through Rolex's proprietary dial layout. Inside beats the self-winding Caliber 9001 developed specifically for Sky-Dweller featuring annual calendar mechanism, dual time zone complication, Chronergy escapement with optimized geometry providing increased efficiency, paramagnetic blue Parachrom hairspring offering superior resistance to shocks and temperature variations, high-performance Paraflex shock absorbers, bidirectional automatic winding via Perpetual rotor, COSC chronometer certification plus additional Superlative Chronometer testing by Rolex guaranteeing precision of minus two to plus two seconds per day after casing, 40 jewels, frequency of 28,800 vibrations per hour, approximately 72 hours of power reserve. Yellow gold three-piece link Oyster bracelet with polished center links and brushed outer links secures with Oysterclasp folding clasp featuring Easylink 5mm comfort extension link.

items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Rolex Datejust 126233 "Wimbledon" dial designation has become one of the most recognizable collector shorthand terms in the modern Rolex lexicon, referring to the slate grey dial with green Roman numerals whose color pairing evokes the All England Club's iconic court surface. Introduced on the current-generation Datejust 36 with caliber 3235, reference 126233 in the two-tone Jubilee configuration represents the most classically proportioned expression of this dial variant — the 36mm case and five-link bracelet rooted in decades of Datejust tradition, while the Wimbledon dial ensures the reference reads as unmistakably contemporary. Authorized dealer waitlists for this specific combination have been a consistent feature of the market since its introduction.

 The 36mm stainless steel case carries an 18-karat yellow gold fluted bezel, paired with the five-link Jubilee bracelet alternating brushed stainless steel and polished yellow gold. The slate lacquer dial presents green Roman numeral hour markers with a luminous rectangular index at twelve, yellow gold dauphine hands, and a date aperture at three o'clock beneath a Cyclops lens. Caliber 3235 powers the movement.

 *This timepiece comes with the original white hang tag.

items.model: Audemars Piguet Royal Oak Offshore 26420RO.OO.A002CA.01 Chronograph Rose Gold Black Dial
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Royal Oak Offshore debuted in 1993 as the Royal Oak's bolder, more virile sibling, establishing an entirely new genre of oversized luxury sport chronographs that has influenced the watchmaking industry ever since. Reference 26420RO belongs to the comprehensive Spring 2021 Royal Oak Offshore redesign, which introduced a refined 43mm case architecture, rearranged subdial layout, and the manufacture's new in-house Caliber 4401 — the first integrated flyback chronograph developed specifically for the Offshore line. Executed in warm 18-karat pink gold with black ceramic accents, this reference exemplifies the modern evolution of the Offshore into a more architecturally refined expression that balances the model's sporting DNA with contemporary luxury material pairings.

 The 43mm case in 18-karat pink gold measures 14.5mm thick, distinguished by the black ceramic octagonal bezel, ceramic pushpieces and screw-locked crown, sandblasted pink gold pushpiece guards, and sapphire caseback. The black "Méga Tapisserie" dial carries rhodium-toned chronograph counters and external zone, pink gold applied hour markers and Royal Oak hands with luminescent coating, black inner bezel, and date aperture between four and five. The in-house automatic Caliber 4401 — with column wheel and vertical clutch — delivers a 70-hour power reserve, completed by a black rubber strap with 18-karat pink gold AP pin buckle plus an additional black alligator strap.

*This timepiece comes with an extra leather strap.

items.model: Patek Philippe Nautilus 7018/1A-010 'Ladies' Stainless Steel Blue Mother Of Pearl Dial Diamond Bezel
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Patek Philippe Nautilus 7018/1A-010 represents Patek Philippe's elegant interpretation of the iconic Nautilus collection designed originally by Gérald Genta in 1976, scaled to 33.6mm to suit feminine wrists while maintaining the distinctive porthole-inspired octagonal bezel and horizontally embossed dial pattern that has defined the collection for nearly five decades. This reference combines the sporty elegance of stainless steel construction with sophisticated embellishments including a factory-set diamond bezel and luxurious blue mother of pearl dial, creating a timepiece that transitions seamlessly from casual to formal occasions while maintaining water resistance appropriate for an active lifestyle. 

 The 33.6mm case crafted in stainless steel features the signature Nautilus octagonal bezel set with approximately 46 brilliant-cut diamonds totaling roughly 0.68 carats, polished surfaces on bezel top and case flanks contrasting with brushed case band, characteristic hinged lugs integrated seamlessly into the bracelet design, sapphire crystal, and transparent sapphire caseback revealing the decorated movement. The blue mother of pearl dial displays applied luminous baton hour markers at all positions except 3 o'clock where the date window resides, polished white gold baton hands with luminous fill, black printed minute track along outer edge, horizontal embossed pattern characteristic of Nautilus dials creating subtle texture and light play across the iridescent mother of pearl surface, and date display at 3 o'clock with white background matching the overall aesthetic. Inside beats the self-winding Caliber 324 S C featuring Gyromax balance wheel, Spiromax balance spring in Silinvar silicon, 29 jewels, frequency of 28,800 vibrations per hour, central rotor in 21-karat gold, Patek Philippe Seal certification guaranteeing exceptional finishing and precision standards, approximately 35 to 45 hours of power reserve. Stainless steel integrated Nautilus bracelet with polished center links and brushed outer links secures with fold-over clasp.

items.sourceDescription:
The  Royal Oak Offshore Diver takes Audemars Piguet's muscular sports watch underwater, pairing the Offshore's bold architecture with genuine dive functionality. Unlike a conventional diver, it hides its rotating timing scale on an inner ring, operated by a second crown so the octagonal silhouette stays intact. This khaki green execution leans into a rugged, military mood, trading the usual dark dials for an earthy tone warmed by rose gold accents, giving the tool watch an unexpectedly refined edge.

 Built in stainless steel, the 42mm case carries the octagonal bezel and eight hexagonal screws, flanked by two crowns, one for the time, a second at ten o'clock to turn the internal dive scale. The khaki green dial wears the oversized Méga Tapisserie pattern, its applied rose gold markers and hands aiding legibility, with a date at three. Robustly water-resistant and finished on a green rubber strap, it is made for depth.

 *This timepiece comes with an additional rubber strap and the original hang tag.

items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
Created in tribute to Roberto Mancini, the celebrated Italian football manager, this  RM 11-01 playfully reimagines Richard Mille's flyback chronograph around the rhythm of a football match. The chronograph's minute track is laid out to follow the beautiful game, marked for each forty-five-minute half, for stoppage time, and for the "Extra Time" and "Overtime" of a tense cup tie. Beneath the sporting theme lies a seriously capable movement combining a flyback chronograph, an annual calendar, and dual time zones.

 The tonneau 50.00 mm x 42.70 mm case is machined from grade-5 titanium, secured by the signature spline screws that have become a Richard Mille hallmark. Behind the sapphire crystal, a skeletonized movement is laid bare in characteristic colourful fashion, its flyback chronograph flanked by an oversized date, a month aperture, and a second time-zone display. Pushers for start-stop and reset-flyback sit beside the crown, letting the wearer time a full ninety minutes, and the drama beyond.

 *This timepiece is on a black rubber strap, not green.

items.model: Patek Philippe Complications Calatrava 5212A-001 Weekly Calendar Stainless Steel Silver Opaline Dial (2020)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The 5212A introduced a complication with no precedent in Patek Philippe's modern catalogue and considerable rarity across the entire industry: the weekly calendar, which displays the ISO week number — the internationally standardised system used across business, logistics, and professional scheduling — alongside the full day name, date, and month on a single dial. The week number scale running around the outer ring, graduated 1 through 53 with months printed between the week clusters, transforms the watch into a professional planning instrument of genuine utility, housed within a round case of classical Patek Philippe proportions. The 5212A's stainless steel construction — a material Patek Philippe deploys with deliberate selectivity across its Complications range — signals accessibility relative to the precious metal catalogue, a reading reinforced by the tan calfskin strap with cream stitching.

 The 40mm stainless steel case carries a polished bezel and screw-down case back. The silver opaline dial presents three concentric rings: an outer ring carrying week numbers 1–53 interspersed with printed month names; a middle ring displaying the full day name; and an inner opaline field with applied baton hour markers and a date aperture at three o'clock. A red-tipped seconds hand provides the sole colour accent. A calfskin strap with cream stitching and stainless steel prong buckle completes the reference. Caliber 26-330 S C J, self-winding, powers the movement.

items.model: A. Lange & Söhne Odysseus 363.068 White Gold Grey Dial
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The reference 363.068 represents A. Lange & Söhne's bold entry into the luxury sports watch category with the Odysseus collection launched in 2019, marking the first time in the manufacture's modern history since its 1994 re-establishment following German reunification that the brand created a timepiece with integrated bracelet design and water resistance suitable for active lifestyles traditionally dominated by Swiss manufactures. This reference demonstrates A. Lange & Söhne's ability to apply the exceptional hand-finishing and movement decoration standards characteristic of their dress watch complications to a sporty design architecture, combining distinctive tonneau-shaped case with integrated three-row bracelet, day-date display complications, and robust construction achieving 120 meters water resistance while maintaining the visual refinement expected from Saxon haute horlogerie. The white gold case construction with grey dial creates sophisticated elegance, appealing to collectors who value both German watchmaking traditions and contemporary sports-elegant design language combined with in-house movement architecture featuring Lange's signature finishing techniques.

 The 40.5mm case crafted in 18-karat white gold features brushed and polished surfaces creating visual contrast, distinctive tonneau shape with rounded edges, integrated lugs flowing seamlessly into three-row bracelet construction, sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating on both sides, screw-down crown ensuring 120 meters of water resistance, and transparent sapphire caseback revealing the meticulously hand-finished movement. The grey dial displays applied luminous baton hour markers, white gold hands with luminous fill, day display in aperture at 3 o'clock, date display in large aperture at 3 o'clock beneath day indication, small seconds subdial at 6 o'clock, all elements arranged with typical Lange precision and visual balance, minute track with printed divisions around outer edge. Inside beats the self-winding Caliber L155.1 DATOMATIC developed specifically for Odysseus collection featuring day-date mechanism with instantaneous jump at midnight, bidirectional winding system, three-quarter plate construction in untreated German silver, hand-engraved balance cock, screwed gold chatons, blued screws, 50 jewels, frequency of 28,800 vibrations per hour, approximately 50 hours of power reserve, movement components finished with traditional Saxon techniques including Glashütte ribbing, perlage, polished bevels. White gold integrated three-row bracelet with brushed center links and polished outer links secures with deployant clasp.

 *This timepiece comes with a travel case, and both a rubber strap and a leather strap.

items.model: Rolex Explorer II 226570 Stainless Steel White Polar Dial (2024)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
Introduced in 1971, the  Explorer II was conceived for a specific breed of adventurer: cave explorers and polar researchers who, deprived of natural light, could lose track of day and night. Its defining feature is a fixed 24-hour bezel read against an orange 24-hour hand, allowing the wearer to tell morning from evening at a glance. Utilitarian where other Rolex watches are decorative, it has become a cult favorite among those who prize function and understated toolwatch character.

 The 42mm case is forged from Rolex's stainless steel and topped by a fixed steel bezel with engraved 24-hour markings, mounted on the brushed and polished Oyster bracelet. The crisp white "Polar" dial, named for the model's expedition heritage, carries bold black-outlined markers and hands for legible contrast, with a date beneath the Cyclops at three o'clock. That single flash of orange on the 24-hour hand nods to the original 1971 reference.

The  Royal Oak ‘Jumbo’ is the truest heir to Gérald Genta’s 1972 original, preserving the extra-thin case and 39mm proportions that launched the luxury sports watch. Revered by purists as the definitive expression of the model, it trades drama for balance and wearability. This all-yellow-gold execution radiates warmth, its champagne tapisserie dial creating a tone-on-tone harmony. Belonging to the generation that reinstated the AP monogram at six o’clock, it unites heritage with the confidence only gold can convey.

 Rendered in 18-karat yellow gold, the 39mm case is slim, its octagonal bezel held by eight hexagonal screws. The champagne dial displays the Grande Tapisserie pattern, gold markers and hands melting into the matching backdrop for a cohesive tone-on-tone effect. A date window sits at three, and the AP monogram anchors six o’clock. The seamlessly integrated gold bracelet tapers fluidly from the case, delivering the comfort and presence of a true icon.

 *This timepiece has factory stickers on the inner-side of the bracelet and buckle.

items.model: Rolex Datejust 41 126334 Stainless Steel White Roman Numerals Dial Jubilee (2020)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Rolex Datejust  has defined understated luxury since 1945, when it debuted as the first self-winding chronometer wristwatch to display the date, paired with the purpose-built Jubilee bracelet created for the occasion. This configuration is perhaps its most classic, uniting elegant Roman numerals with the supple five-link Jubilee for a look that reads dressier than any sports Rolex. In the modern 41mm size, it balances presence and refinement effortlessly. It remains the quintessential all-occasion Rolex.

 The 41mm stainless steel Oyster case is crowned by a fluted 18-karat white gold bezel that adds formality. Its crisp white dial is marked by applied Roman numerals, slender baton hands, and the date at three magnified beneath the Cyclops lens. The self-winding Caliber 3235 drives it with reliability. Completing the look, the five-piece Jubilee bracelet, first designed for the original Datejust, drapes around the wrist, its polished center links adding a dressy shimmer.

 *This timepiece comes with the original white hang tag.

items.model: Rolex Datejust 36 126231 Stainless Steel Rose Gold Black Diamond Dial Jubilee (2022)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The  Datejust has long served as Rolex’s most versatile and enduring ambassador, and this two-tone execution amplifies its appeal by marrying robust stainless steel with warm rose gold. The pairing speaks to a collector who desires presence without ostentation, blending everyday durability with the inviting glow of precious metal. Since the model pioneered the date-in-a-window complication in 1945, it has defined refined wristwear, and this steel-and-gold rendition carries that pedigree with contemporary warmth and understated, unmistakably luxurious confidence.

 Measuring 36mm, the stainless steel case is topped by a fluted rose gold bezel whose grooves scatter light with characteristic flair. The lacquered black dial creates a bold canvas for ten diamond hour markers, while the date sits at three beneath the magnifying Cyclops lens. Rose gold centre links run through the five-piece Jubilee bracelet, interweaving with steel to echo the case’s two-tone harmony and lending supple, refined comfort across the wrist.

 *This timepiece comes with the original white hang tag.

items.model: Rolex Day-Date 40 228239 White Gold Silver Diamond Baguette Dial (2024)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Rolex Day-Date  has reigned as Rolex's flagship statement piece since 1956, the first wristwatch to spell out the day in full and produced exclusively in precious metals, earning its enduring "President's Watch" sobriquet. Reference 228239 represents the 40mm execution in 18-karat white gold — the most discreet of the metal options, lending the watch a monochromatic restraint that differs markedly from the overt warmth of the yellow and rose gold variants. Configured here with a silver dial set with baguette-cut diamond markers and finished with the signature fluted bezel, it appeals to collectors who favor understated prestige, where the precious-metal pedigree reveals itself only on closer inspection.

 The 40mm case in 18-karat white gold features a fluted bezel and Twinlock screw-down crown, framing a silver dial appointed with ten baguette-cut diamond hour markers, day aperture at twelve, and date at three beneath the Cyclops magnifier. The in-house automatic Caliber 3255 — equipped with the Chronergy escapement, paramagnetic Parachrom hairspring, and Paraflex shock absorbers — delivers a 70-hour power reserve and Superlative Chronometer certification, accurate to -2/+2 seconds per day. items.model: Rolex Day-Date 36 128345RBR Rose Gold Eisenkiesel Diamond Dial Diamond Bezel (2022)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
Since 1956, the  Day-Date has reigned as Rolex’s most prestigious creation, the first wristwatch to display the day of the week spelled fully across the dial. Reserved exclusively for precious metals, it became the watch of presidents and visionaries, earning its ‘President’ sobriquet. This rose gold interpretation elevates that legacy to extraordinary heights, pairing a rare natural stone dial with a lavish diamond treatment. It represents the summit of the collection, a statement of opulence and horological distinction.

 The 36mm rose gold case is framed by a bezel glittering with brilliant-cut diamonds, encircling a mesmerizing Eisenkiesel dial whose natural iron-quartz veining renders every example unique. Diamond-set Roman numerals mark the hours, with the day displayed in full at twelve and the date magnified beneath the Cyclops at three. The semi-circular three-piece President bracelet carries diamonds along its central links, completing a dazzling composition of precious stone and rose gold brilliance.

items.model: Rolex Day-Date 40 228349RBR White Gold Black Diamond Baguette Dial Diamond Bezel (2022)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Rolex Day-Date 40 in white gold with diamond bezel and baguette diamond dial represents the reference at its most explicitly jewelry-oriented — a configuration that positions the watch within a tradition of diamond-set Day-Dates extending back to the reference's 1956 introduction, when Rolex first established the precedent of offering its presidential watch with factory gem-setting of exceptional quality. The combination of a round brilliant-cut diamond bezel with baguette-cut diamond hour markers on a black dial is among the most visually commanding configurations in the current Day-Date range: the geometric precision of the baguettes against the deep black ground, surrounded by the scintillating brilliance of the round bezel diamonds, creates a layered gem-setting narrative that distinguishes this reference from any single-cut approach. The white gold and black dial pairing produces a cooler, more contemporary register than the yellow gold equivalent.

 The 40mm white gold Oyster case carries a bezel set with a continuous row of round brilliant-cut diamonds and a white gold screw-down crown. The black dial presents ten baguette-cut diamond hour markers alongside two larger baguette-cut markers at six and twelve o'clock, with a spelled-out day aperture at twelve and a date window at three o'clock beneath a Cyclops lens. White gold pointed hands complete the dial. The President bracelet in white gold with concealed Crownclasp completes the reference. Caliber 3255 powers the movement.

 *This timepiece comes with the original white hang tag.

items.model: Rolex Day-Date 36 128238 Yellow Gold White Mother of Pearl Diamond Dial (2026)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Rolex Day-Date  occupies the summit of Rolex's catalog as the "President" — introduced in 1956 as the first wristwatch to display both the date and the day of the week spelled out in full through separate apertures. Reserved exclusively for precious metals since its inception, the model earned its nickname through the distinctive President bracelet and its association with heads of state and cultural icons who elevated it to a status symbol without equal. Reference 128238 represents the modern 36mm expression in 18-karat yellow gold, executed here with one of Rolex's most jewelry-forward dial configurations — natural white mother-of-pearl accented by factory-set diamonds, with distinctive baguette-cut diamonds at six and nine o'clock creating a mixed-cut arrangement unique to Rolex's high-jewelry Day-Dates.

 The 36mm Oyster case in 18-karat yellow gold features a fluted yellow gold bezel and Twinlock screw-down crown. The white mother-of-pearl dial carries diamond hour markers in 18-karat gold settings with baguette-cut diamonds at six and nine, day aperture at twelve, date aperture at three beneath the Cyclops, and yellow gold hands with luminescent fill. The in-house automatic Caliber 3255 — equipped with the Chronergy escapement, paramagnetic Parachrom hairspring, and Paraflex shock absorbers — delivers a 70-hour power reserve and Superlative Chronometer certification, completed by the signature President bracelet with semi-circular three-piece links and concealed folding Crownclasp.

 *This timepiece comes with the original white hang tag.

items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
Since 1956, the Rolex Day-Date has reigned as the "President," the first wristwatch to display the day of the week spelled in full and, crafted exclusively in precious metals, the definitive watch of leaders and achievers. This particular rendition wraps that prestige in warmth and glamour, pairing rich rose gold with a chocolate dial and a dazzling diamond bezel. It represents the Day-Date at its most luxuriously indulgent, where a symbol of accomplishment becomes outright jewelry.

 The 40mm case is crafted in 18-karat rose gold and crowned by a bezel set with brilliant-cut diamonds, throwing light in every direction. Its warm chocolate dial glows against baguette-cut diamond hour markers, with the day spelled in full through an arc at twelve and a date at three beneath the Cyclops. The self-winding Caliber 3255 powers it. Completing the design, the semi-circular-link President bracelet in matching rose gold delivers unmistakable prestige and comfort.

 *This timepiece comes with an XL old-style box and original hang tag.

items.model: Patek Philippe Complications 4947/1A-001 Annual Calendar Moon Phases Stainless Steel Blue Dial (2025)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Patek Philippe Complications  4947/1A-001 represents Patek Philippe's elegant ladies' interpretation of the annual calendar complication automatically accounting for months of varying lengths requiring manual correction only once per year on March 1st, introduced as part of the manufacture's commitment to creating sophisticated complications specifically proportioned and designed for women rather than simply reducing men's models. This reference combines the practical annual calendar functionality first developed by Patek Philippe in 1996 with moon phase indication showing lunar cycle accuracy of one day's deviation every 122 years, housed in the relatively rare stainless steel case construction paired with integrated five-row steel bracelet making haute horlogerie complications more accessible while maintaining the finishing standards and mechanical excellence expected from one of Geneva's most prestigious manufactures founded in 1839. The striking midnight blue dial with distinctive "shantung" finish featuring vertical and horizontal satin-brushing creates contemporary elegance, appealing to collectors who value both technical complications and refined aesthetics combined with current-production availability backed by Patek Philippe's comprehensive warranty and global service network.

 The 38mm case crafted in stainless steel features polished surfaces, case thickness of 11mm, water resistance to 30 meters, sapphire crystal, recessed correctors in case band for independent adjustment of calendar functions, and transparent sapphire caseback revealing the meticulously finished movement. The midnight blue dial features "shantung" pattern created through vertical and horizontal satin-finish technique creating unique texture and light play, applied white gold Arabic numerals at 12, 3, 6, and 9 positions, white gold leaf-shaped hands with white luminescent coating, sweep seconds hand, day indication by pointer hand at 9 o'clock subdial, date indication by pointer hand at 3 o'clock subdial, combined month and moon phase display at 6 o'clock position showing month in aperture with realistic moon disk rotating against blue starfield background. Inside beats the self-winding Caliber 26-330 S QA LU featuring annual calendar mechanism with day and month indicated by hands and date displayed in aperture, moon phase complication, sweep seconds, diameter of 32mm, thickness of 5.32mm, 319 total parts, 34 jewels, central winding rotor in 21-karat gold, Gyromax balance wheel, Spiromax balance spring in Silinvar silicon, frequency of 28,800 semi-oscillations per hour, minimum 35 hours to maximum 45 hours power reserve, Patek Philippe Seal certification guaranteeing exceptional finishing and precision standards. Stainless steel integrated five-row bracelet secures with patented Patek Philippe fold-over clasp featuring four independent catches.

 *This timepiece comes with the original hang tag.

items.model: Rolex Day-Date 40 228348RBR Yellow Gold Champagne Diamond Baguette Dial Diamond Bezel (2021)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Rolex Day-Date  has held its position as Rolex's flagship statement piece since 1956, the first wristwatch to spell the day of the week in full and produced exclusively in precious metals throughout its history. Worn by numerous world leaders, it earned its enduring "President's Watch" sobriquet and remains the most esteemed model in the Oyster collection. Reference 228348RBR represents the gem-set expression of the modern 40mm generation in 18-karat yellow gold, the "RBR" suffix denoting its factory diamond-set bezel. Configured here with a champagne dial bearing baguette-cut diamond markers, it appeals to collectors drawn to the convergence of presidential heritage with overt factory gem-setting.

 The 40mm case in 18-karat yellow gold carries a bezel set with brilliant-cut diamonds and frames a champagne dial appointed with ten baguette-cut diamond hour markers in yellow gold settings, day aperture at twelve, and date at three beneath the Cyclops magnifier. The in-house automatic Caliber 3255 — equipped with the Chronergy escapement, Parachrom hairspring, and Paraflex shock absorbers — delivers a 70-hour power reserve and Superlative Chronometer certification. The watch is completed by a solid yellow gold President bracelet with semi-circular three-piece links and concealed folding Crownclasp.

items.model: Rolex Daytona 116509 White Gold Meteorite Dial (2023)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Daytona traces to 1963, when Rolex conceived it as a professional racing chronograph and named it for the Florida circuit synonymous with high-speed endurance competition. Reference 116509 represents the previous-generation full white gold Daytona, elevated at Baselworld 2021 by the introduction of the meteorite dial as part of a trio of "meteorite panda" configurations that also included yellow gold and Everose executions. The dial is sliced from the Gibeon meteorite — discovered near the Namibian town in 1836 — whose distinctive Widmanstätten crystalline pattern formed over millions of years in space, ensuring every example remains genuinely one of a kind. The reference has since been superseded by the current-generation 126509, adding collectibility to this specific execution.

 The 40mm case in 18-karat white gold features a fixed engraved tachymeter bezel and Triplock screw-down crown with matching chronograph pushers. The meteorite dial carries three contrasting black subdials in a reverse-panda configuration, red "Daytona" text above six o'clock echoing vintage examples, white gold applied index markers with Chromalight luminescence, and matching white gold hands. The in-house automatic Caliber 4130 — a self-winding chronograph with column wheel and vertical clutch — delivers a 72-hour power reserve, completed by an 18-karat white gold Oyster bracelet with Oysterlock folding safety clasp.

items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Richard Mille RM 72-01 Lifestyle In-House Chronograph in white ceramic exemplifies the brand's commitment to blending avant-garde materials with sophisticated horology. Crafted from ATZ white ceramic, renowned for its exceptional scratch resistance and whiteness, the case measures 38.40mm x 47.34mm. This material not only enhances durability but also offers a striking contrast to the skeletonized dial, which reveals the intricate mechanics beneath. The watch's tonneau-shaped case is complemented by a white rubber strap, reinforcing its contemporary aesthetic.

 At the heart of this timepiece lies Richard Mille's first in-house chronograph movement, the CRMC1, featuring a patented flyback function. This innovative movement allows for seamless resetting of the chronograph without stopping, a testament to the brand's technical prowess. The dial showcases 24-hour and 60-minute counters positioned at 5 o’clock and 2 o’clock respectively, enabling the timing of extended periods—a rarity in chronographs. The skeletonized design not only offers a glimpse into the movement's complexity but also underscores the meticulous craftsmanship that appeals to discerning collectors.

items.model: Rolex Day-Date 40 228345RBR Rose Gold Olive Green Roman Numerals Dial Diamond Bezel (2021)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Rolex Day-Date 228345RBR represents the contemporary evolution of Rolex's most prestigious collection introduced in 1956 as the world's first wristwatch to display both the date and fully spelled-out day of the week in an aperture, immediately becoming known as the "President's watch" due to its association with world leaders, CEOs, and influential figures throughout the latter half of the 20th century. This reference combines the modern 40mm case proportions introduced in 2015 replacing the previous 36mm standard with sophisticated embellishments including factory-set diamond bezel and the highly sought-after olive green dial finish that has become one of Rolex's most popular contemporary color offerings across multiple collections. Exclusively available in precious metals throughout its entire production history and never offered in stainless steel, the Day-Date continues to represent the pinnacle of Rolex's catalog, appealing to collectors who value both the heritage of this iconic reference and modern manufacturing excellence combined with luxurious materials and gem-setting craftsmanship.

 The 40mm case crafted in 18-karat rose gold features polished bezel set with 52 brilliant-cut diamonds arranged in continuous setting around full circumference, polished case flanks, screw-down Twinlock crown with double waterproofness system ensuring 100 meters of water resistance, sapphire crystal with Cyclops lens magnifying the date 2.5 times, and screw-down caseback. The olive green sunburst dial displays applied 18-karat rose gold Roman numeral hour markers at XII, III, VI, and IX positions with rose gold stick markers at remaining positions, polished rose gold hands, day display in arc-shaped aperture at 12 o'clock showing fully spelled-out day of week, instantaneous date display at 3 o'clock with white background, minute track with printed divisions around outer edge creating refined contrast against olive green background. Inside beats the self-winding Caliber 3255 introduced in 2015 featuring Chronergy escapement with optimized geometry providing increased efficiency and approximately 15 percent improved power reserve compared to previous generation, paramagnetic blue Parachrom hairspring offering greater resistance to shocks and temperature variations, high-performance Paraflex shock absorbers, bidirectional automatic winding via Perpetual rotor, COSC chronometer certification plus additional Superlative Chronometer testing by Rolex guaranteeing precision of minus two to plus two seconds per day after casing, 31 jewels, frequency of 28,800 vibrations per hour, approximately 70 hours of power reserve allowing watch to be set down Friday evening and resume accurate timekeeping Monday morning. Rose gold three-piece link President bracelet with semi-circular elements and polished surfaces throughout secures with concealed Crownclasp folding clasp.

 *This timepiece comes with the original white hang tag.

items.model: Patek Philippe Celestial Grand Complications 5102G-001 White Gold (2005)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Celestial 5102 represents one of Patek Philippe's most poetic and mechanically ambitious modern creations — introduced in 2002 as the first Patek Philippe wristwatch to feature a functional astronomical display, a simpler wearable interpretation of the ultra-complex Sky Moon Tourbillon. Reference 5102G-001, the original white gold execution produced until approximately 2012, presents a real-time chart of the Northern Hemisphere's night sky through three superimposed rotating sapphire crystal discs — the inner mapping stars and the Milky Way, others tracking the moon's phases and elliptical orbit. Patek Philippe's engineers researched twenty-five trillion ratio combinations to achieve the precision required, with only approximately thirty-five examples produced annually and each requiring some eighteen months to complete.

 The 43mm case in 18-karat white gold features caseband hand-engraved with Calatrava crosses and a sapphire caseback revealing the movement. The deep blue celestial dial displays the golden Milky Way arcing across, an elliptical golden line framing the sky visible from Geneva at 46°20' latitude, moon phase and orbit indicators, cardinal direction markers, and pierced white gold hands. The self-winding Caliber 240 LU CL C — a 315-part ultra-thin movement with 22-karat gold micro-rotor — delivers 48 hours of power reserve with sidereal accuracy of 0.088 seconds per day, completed by a black alligator strap with white gold pin buckle.

 *This timepiece comes with the original box and Patek Philippe Archive Papers.

items.model: Patek Philippe Complications 5960P-001 Annual Calendar Chronograph Platinum (2008)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The 5960P-001 marks a landmark moment in Patek Philippe's modern history — introduced in 2006 as the first self-winding chronograph movement ever developed and manufactured entirely in-house by the maison, ending decades of reliance on modified Lémania ébauches. It combined this technical achievement with the  annual calendar complication that Patek Philippe patented in 1996 as the first brand to produce one, creating a genuinely groundbreaking pairing within a single wristwatch. Produced until 2013, the reference has since attained celebrated status among collectors as the piece that launched Patek's contemporary chronograph program. Executed here in platinum — Patek's most prestigious metal — it carries the signature single diamond set into the case flank at six o'clock, the maison's subtle luxury identifier.

 The 40.5mm case in platinum measures 13.5mm thick and features a sapphire caseback revealing the movement. The grey sunburst dial displays three calendar apertures across the top for day, large date, and month, a monocounter chronograph at six consolidating hours and minutes with a day/night indicator, power reserve at twelve, and luminescent applied baton markers and leaf-shaped hands. The automatic Caliber CH 28-520 IRM QA 24H — a vertical clutch flyback column-wheel chronograph with 21-karat gold rotor — delivers 55 hours of reserve and carries the Patek Philippe Seal, completed by an alligator strap with platinum deployant clasp.

items.model: Rolex Daytona 116588SACO Yellow Gold Orange Sapphire Bezel Black Diamond Dial (2023)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Daytona traces to 1963, when Rolex conceived it as a professional racing chronograph named for the Florida circuit synonymous with high-speed endurance competition. Reference 116588SACO belongs to Rolex's rarefied off-catalog gem-set productions — pieces never listed in the official catalog and reserved for the maison's most established clients, adding a layer of exclusivity beyond even the standard precious-metal Daytonas. The "SACO" designation is Rolex's internal code identifying the factory orange sapphire baguette bezel treatment, which arranges thirty-six graduated stones in a fiery sunset ombré across the yellow gold case. Combined with the black dial and diamond hour markers, the configuration achieves one of the most vivid and unmistakable chromatic statements in modern Rolex production.

 The 40mm case in 18-karat yellow gold measures 12.4mm thick, framed by the factory-set baguette orange sapphire bezel with matching Triplock screw-down crown and pushers. The black lacquer dial carries diamond hour markers, three snailed golden subdials at three, six, and nine, red "Daytona" text above six, and gold-tone hands with luminescent fill. The in-house automatic Caliber 4130 — a self-winding chronograph with column wheel and vertical clutch — delivers a 72-hour power reserve and Superlative Chronometer certification, completed by a black Oysterflex bracelet with 18-karat yellow gold Oysterlock safety clasp.

items.model: Audemars Piguet Royal Oak Offshore 26405CE.OO.A056CA.01 Chronograph (2020)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Royal Oak Offshore debuted in 1993 as the Royal Oak's bolder, more virile sibling, conceived to push the original 1972 design language into more imposing territory. Reference 26405CE represents the model executed almost entirely in ceramic — a black ceramic case framed by a contrasting green ceramic bezel, pushers, and crown — with titanium accents providing structural counterpoint. Ceramic finishing on the Offshore architecture is notoriously demanding given the material's hardness, requiring vastly more time than metal to achieve the alternating brushed and polished surfaces, and the two-tone construction makes this configuration among the more visually distinctive ceramic Offshores in the catalog.

 The 43mm case in black ceramic carries a green ceramic bezel secured by white gold hexagonal screws, with green ceramic pushers and screw-locked crown guarded by titanium pushpiece protectors. The smoked green "Méga Tapisserie" dial features rhodium-toned counters, a black inner bezel, and pink gold applied Arabic numerals and Royal Oak hands with luminescent coating, with the date at three. The in-house automatic Caliber 3126/3840 — visible through the sapphire caseback via its 22-karat gold rotor — delivers a 50-hour power reserve, completed by a green rubber strap with textile decoration and titanium pin buckle.

items.sourceDescription:
The Rolex Submariner  occupies foundational status in the history of the wristwatch, having effectively defined the dive watch as a category since its 1953 introduction. Reference 124060 is the current No Date execution, the configuration purists regard as the truest expression of the design — its dial uninterrupted by a date aperture or Cyclops lens, preserving the perfect symmetry that has made the Submariner one of the most recognizable objects in watchmaking. Introduced in 2020 as successor to the 114060, this generation refined the model with a larger case and slimmer lugs, reaffirming the reference's standing as the archetype against which all other dive watches are measured.

 The 41mm case in stainless steel features a unidirectional rotating bezel with a black Cerachrom ceramic insert, its 60-minute graduations coated in platinum, and is water resistant to 300 meters. The black lacquer dial carries 18-karat white gold hour markers and hands filled with blue-glow Chromalight. The in-house automatic Caliber 3230, equipped with the Chronergy escapement and Parachrom hairspring, delivers a 70-hour power reserve and Superlative Chronometer certification, completed by a stainless steel Oyster bracelet with Glidelock extension clasp.

 *This timepiece comes with the original white hang tag.

 The 44mm case in stainless steel measures 14.4mm thick, framed by a green ceramic bezel secured with eight white gold hexagonal screws and matching green ceramic screw-locked crown and pushers. The anthracite "Méga Tapisserie" dial carries silver-toned counters, white gold applied markers with luminescence, and red chronograph accents. The hand-finished Caliber 3126/3840, wound by a 22-karat galvanic-coated gold rotor, delivers a 50-hour power reserve, completed by a black rubber strap with titanium folding clasp.

Built on a grade-5 titanium baseplate, the movement delivers 55 hours of reserve, completed by a black-and-orange rubber strap bearing McLaren's Speedmark logo.

items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Rolex   Datejust  126333 represents the contemporary evolution of the Datejust collection introduced in 1945 as the world's first self-winding waterproof chronometer wristwatch with automatically changing date display, reimagined in 2016 with updated 41mm proportions and new-generation Caliber 3235 movement offering enhanced precision and extended 70-hour power reserve. This reference combines the classic two-tone construction pairing stainless steel with 18-karat yellow gold creating the distinctive aesthetic Rolex designates as Rolesor with the elegant five-piece link Jubilee bracelet originally created in 1945 specifically for the Datejust and the timeless champagne sunburst dial finish offering versatile elegance suitable for both professional and formal occasions. As a current-production model backed by Rolex's comprehensive warranty and global service network, this Datejust 41 appeals to collectors who value both the heritage of Rolex's most iconic dress watch collection spanning eight decades and accessible luxury through two-tone construction offering precious metal accents at lower cost than solid gold.

 The 41mm case crafted in stainless steel and 18-karat yellow gold features fluted bezel in solid yellow gold creating the signature Datejust profile with distinctive ridged texture, monobloc middle case in stainless steel, polished case flanks, screw-down Twinlock crown with double waterproofness system ensuring 100 meters of water resistance, sapphire crystal with Cyclops lens magnifying the date 2.5 times for easy reading, and screw-down caseback. The champagne sunburst dial displays applied yellow gold stick hour markers at all positions, yellow gold hands, minute track with printed divisions around outer edge, instantaneous date display at 3 o'clock with white background magnified through Cyclops lens, sunburst finish creating radial pattern emanating from center creating warm glow and dimensional depth as dial catches light from different angles. Inside beats the self-winding Caliber 3235 introduced in 2015 featuring Chronergy escapement with optimized geometry providing approximately 15 percent improved power reserve compared to previous generation movements, paramagnetic blue Parachrom hairspring offering superior resistance to shocks and temperature variations, high-performance Paraflex shock absorbers, bidirectional automatic winding via Perpetual rotor, COSC chronometer certification plus additional Superlative Chronometer testing by Rolex guaranteeing precision of minus two to plus two seconds per day after casing, 31 jewels, frequency of 28,800 vibrations per hour, approximately 70 hours of power reserve. Stainless steel and yellow gold five-piece link Jubilee bracelet with semi-circular elements in polished surfaces throughout secures with Oysterclasp folding clasp featuring Easylink 5mm comfort extension link.

items.sourceDescription:
The Laptimer represents one of Audemars Piguet's most technically ambitious creations of the modern era — the world's first mechanical chronograph with alternating flyback functionality, developed at Michael Schumacher's specific request to measure consecutive lap times on the racetrack. Designed in collaboration with the seven-time Formula 1 World Champion and engineered by AP's high-complications subsidiary Renaud & Papi, the reference is limited to just 221 pieces, the precise number of Grand Prix races in which Schumacher competed. Two central chronograph seconds hands operate independently or simultaneously, allowing the wearer to time consecutive laps without interruption — a complication that had never existed mechanically before its 2015 debut.

 The 44mm case in forged carbon is paired with a brushed titanium octagonal bezel, black ceramic pushers and crown, and a titanium display caseback engraved with Schumacher's signature. The openworked dial reveals the architecture beneath, featuring luminescent 18-karat white gold hands, a thirty-minute counter at three, and small seconds at nine. The hand-wound Caliber 2923 — comprising 413 components and three column wheels, two of which drive the patented laptimer — delivers an 80-hour power reserve, completed by a black rubber strap with titanium folding clasp.

*This is a limited edition of 221 pieces.

items.model: Patek Philippe Grand Complications 5270G-001 Perpetual Calendar White Gold White Dial (2011)
items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Grand Complications 5270G-001 occupies landmark status in modern Patek Philippe history as the maison's very first in-house perpetual calendar chronograph — introduced in 2011 as the culmination of decades of movement development that finally freed Patek from its reliance on modified Lémania ébauches for its most prestigious chronograph complications. Perpetual calendar chronographs have long ranked among the most coveted and collectible wristwatches in the entire market — appearing on more auction catalogue covers than any other watch type — making the 5270G-001 an instant landmark upon its release. Produced only from 2011 through late 2013 before being superseded by the -013 variant with a redesigned dial, this first-series reference has since attained particular collector distinction, identified through its distinctive black gold indexes.

 The 41mm case in 18-karat white gold measures 12.4mm thick, featuring a concave bezel, two-tier lugs, and sapphire display caseback revealing the movement. The silvery opaline dial displays black gold indexes, day and month double apertures at twelve, moon phase and date-by-hand at six, thirty-minute chronograph counter at three, small seconds at nine, and day/night and leap year indicators. The hand-wound Caliber CH 29-535 PS Q — a 456-part column-wheel chronograph with silent operation and six patented innovations — delivers a 65-hour power reserve, completed by a black hand-stitched alligator strap with 18-karat white gold fold-over clasp.

*This timepiece comes with a caseback and a stylus.

 The tonneau case measures 50 x 42.7mm in 18-karat white gold, brushed and satin-finished with polished bevels, paired with a grade-5 titanium baseplate within and sapphire crystal front and back. The skeletonized dial reveals the automatic Caliber RMAC1 — featuring a flyback chronograph with 60-minute countdown at nine, 12-hour totalizer at three, small seconds at six, and an oversized date at twelve with red surround and annual calendar month indicator. The movement, with its variable-geometry rotor, delivers approximately 50 hours of reserve, completed by a white rubber strap with titanium folding clasp.

items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The Royal Oak Double Balance Wheel Openworked represents a halo model within Audemars Piguet's catalog, marrying Gérald Genta's 1972 design with one of the brand's most consequential mechanical patents. The double balance system — two mirrored balance wheels and hairsprings stacked on a single axis — enhances stability and precision by averaging out the oscillations of both regulators. Introduced in 2016 in 41mm and subsequently in 37mm with frosted or gem-set executions, the model arrived in 2024 in the classic brushed-and-polished gold finish in this smaller size for the first time, giving collectors a more traditional finishing pairing with the patented caliber that had previously been reserved for the larger or jeweled variants.

 The 37mm case in 18-karat rose gold measures 10mm thick, satin-brushed with polished bevels and the signature octagonal bezel. The openworked rhodium-toned dial reveals the movement's architecture beneath rose gold applied hour markers and luminescent Royal Oak hands, with the patented double balance mechanism visible at eight o'clock. The self-winding in-house Caliber 3132, comprising 245 components and 38 jewels, delivers a 45-hour power reserve and is visible through the sapphire caseback. An integrated rose gold Royal Oak bracelet with AP folding clasp completes the watch.

 *This timepiece has an old-style box.

items.sourceDescription:
The  Royal Oak needs no introduction, but the Tourbillon Chronograph Openworked represents its most elevated expression, where Gérald Genta's 1972 sports icon becomes a canvas for haute horlogerie's greatest arts. Combining a tourbillon, which counters gravity's effect on timekeeping, with a chronograph and full skeletonization, it demands mastery few houses possess. Its openworked dial lays the movement bare, a mesmerizing tourbillon rotating at six, twin chronograph counters flanking the center, and an inner tachymeter scale. Rose gold applied markers and hands add warmth against skeletonized bridges. The hand-wound tourbillon chronograph movement drives it all, integrated seamlessly into a matching titanium bracelet.

The annual calendar itself — a Patek invention of 1996 — represents one of the maison's signature contributions to modern watchmaking, automatically accounting for months of thirty and thirty-one days while requiring correction only once a year. For collectors, the reference offers a compelling balance: the everyday wearability and unmistakable identity of the Nautilus combined with a genuinely useful complication, executed in steel and offered on a leather strap rather than the familiar integrated bracelet.

 The 40.5mm case in stainless steel measures 11.3mm thick, retaining the signature rounded octagonal bezel with alternating satin and polished finishes. The sunburst charcoal grey dial with black-gradient rim carries horizontal embossing, white gold applied baton markers, and luminescent hands, with day, date, and month apertures beneath twelve and a combined moon phase and 24-hour subdial at six. The self-winding Caliber 324 S QA LU 24H/303, visible through the sapphire caseback, delivers a 45-hour power reserve, completed by a black alligator strap with fold-over deployant clasp.

*This timepiece comes with the Patek Phillipe stylus and original tag.

items.description: Presented for private inquiry. Please confirm the exact available piece, condition, documentation and price.
items.sourceDescription:
The "Legacy" Royal Oak Offshore chronograph commemorates one of watchmaking's most storied partnerships — the decade-long collaboration between Audemars Piguet and Arnold Schwarzenegger, whose on-screen appearances wearing oversized Offshores helped cement the model's action-hero mystique. Released in 2011 in a limited edition of 1,500 pieces, it was conceived as the final chapter in the series the two created together. The combination of black ceramic, titanium, and rose gold makes it among the most coveted Offshores, while its imposing 48mm presence and exceptionally complex ceramic finishing — requiring brushed, bead-blasted, and polished surfaces on a famously unforgiving material — distinguish it as a genuine statement piece.

 The 48mm case, bezel, and crown are executed in black ceramic with bead-blasted titanium screws, caseback, and case protectors, the crown set with a rose gold AP-engraved disc. The black "Méga Tapisserie" dial carries applied rose gold Arabic numerals and faceted hands with luminescence, three recessed subdials with rose gold trim, a raised rose gold flange bearing the tachymeter scale, small seconds at twelve, and a date at three. The automatic Caliber 2326/2840 chronograph delivers a 38-hour power reserve, with rose gold pushers and a strap secured by an oversized titanium buckle.

 *This timepiece comes with the original hang tag and an additional strap.
